label: Violation of Park Rules. Obstructing Public Use. Restroom/Comfort Station
complaints: I went to Central Park this morning and the public restrooms were locked, even though it’s a weekend. It’s really frustrating because it’s a busy area and families with kids need access!
The park benches are constantly taken over by people setting up picnics, making it difficult for others to just sit and enjoy the park. Can’t we have some common courtesy?
I was at Prospect Park yesterday and the restroom was a total mess. No toilet paper and it smelled awful! It’s disappointing since it’s such a popular place for families and activities.

Every morning, I walk my dog in Tompkins Square Park and there are always kids playing ball in the areas where people are trying to walk. It’s getting really dangerous; can we please enforce some boundaries?

label: Noise - House of Worship. Banging/Pounding
complaints: I'm calling to report some really loud banging noises coming from the church down the street. It started around 8 AM and has been going on for over an hour now. It's making it impossible for me to concentrate on my work from home.

Every Sunday, the noise from the temple next door is unbearable. They seem to start their activities at 7 AM, and the banging and pounding continues for several hours. It disrupts my sleep and it's really frustrating!

I live near a mosque and the loud banging that starts in the late afternoon is ruining my evenings. I understand they have their practices, but the noise is excessive and it goes on for far too long. I've called before, but nothing seems to change.

There's a church across the street that has been making a lot of noise today. It sounds like construction or some kind of renovation work. I can hear it clearly in my apartment and it's really disruptive, especially on a weekday afternoon.

label: Maintenance or Facility. Structure - Outdoors. Ball Fields & Equipment
complaints: The baseball field at Riverside Park has been in terrible shape all season. The outfield is basically a mud pit, and it's making it impossible for the kids to play their games.
I took my son to the playground at Fort Greene Park yesterday, and one of the swings was broken. He was really disappointed, and it's not the first time I've seen equipment in disrepair there.

Every time I go to the field at Van Cortlandt Park, I find the benches covered in graffiti, and the entire area feels neglected. We need better maintenance of these community spaces for our kids and families.
I tried to take my daughter for a picnic near the soccer field at McCarren Park, but the whole area smelled awful because of the trash piling up. Can someone please send someone to clean it up?

label: Bench. Damaged/Bent/Loose/Leaning
complaints: I was sitting on the bench at Washington Square Park, and it felt unstable. I think it's leaning to one side; I was worried I'd fall off.
The bench on 8th Avenue near the subway entrance is badly bent. It’s not only uncomfortable, but it seems unsafe for anyone trying to sit down.
I noticed that the bench in front of my apartment building on 52nd Street has been loose for weeks. It wobbles a lot, and I'm afraid someone could get hurt.
The bench at Union Square has a big crack in it. It’s been like that for days, and I saw someone drop their coffee when they sat down on it. Something needs to be done.

label: Consumer Complaint. Tow Truck Company. Towing Illegal or Unfair
complaints: I just got my car towed from a spot that I thought was legal. I parked there for only an hour and the signs were confusing. I feel totally ripped off because the whole thing cost me $200 just for a quick errand. Can someone please help me figure this out?

I parked my car legally, or at least I thought so, but when I came back it was gone. I never saw any tow truck in the area when I left. Now I have to pay a hefty fee to get it back, and I don't think that's fair. This has been really stressful!

I just had the worst experience. I parked in front of my building, and a tow truck showed up within minutes to take my car away. I’ve been a resident here for years and this has never happened before. I want to know why this company is targeting my block – it feels like a scam!

I was at a grocery store for less than half an hour and came back to find my car gone. There were no clear signs saying I couldn’t park there. It’s really upsetting to pay almost $300 to get it back when I was just running a quick errand. I need advice on how to challenge this!

label: Flooring/Stairs. Stairs. Handrail Missing From Wall
complaints: I just moved into my building and I've noticed that the handrail on the stairs is completely missing. It's a really steep flight, and I'm worried someone is going to slip and hurt themselves. Could you please send someone to fix this?

There’s a handrail missing from the stairs in our building and it’s been like this for weeks. I live on the fifth floor and have to carry groceries up and down. It’s dangerous, especially for older residents! This needs to be addressed ASAP.

I’m calling to report that the handrail on the staircase is gone! I have small kids, and it makes me really nervous when they go up and down without something to hold on to. We need this fixed before someone gets hurt.

The handrail on the stairs leading to my apartment has been missing for a month now. It’s really hard for my elderly neighbor to navigate those stairs without any support. Please do something about this quickly!

label: Maintenance or Facility. Structure - Outdoors. Ball Field/Court Lighting
complaints: The lights at the local basketball courts haven’t been working for weeks now. It’s really frustrating because I can’t play in the evenings anymore, and I know a lot of my friends feel the same way. Can someone please get this fixed?
I went to the baseball field last night and the lights were completely out. This isn't just an inconvenience; it’s dangerous for the kids playing there after dark. We need to get this resolved ASAP!

I was hoping to shoot some hoops after work, but the lighting at the court is so dim that I couldn’t see anything. It's been like this for a couple of days now. It just makes it impossible to play and enjoy the space.

The field across from my apartment is great, but the lighting is terrible at night. I've heard complaints from others too. It’s been out for about a week, and I’m worried someone might trip or get hurt without enough light.

label: Street Sign - Damaged. St Name - Attached to Pole
complaints: I just walked by the intersection of 5th Avenue and 10th Street, and I noticed the street sign is hanging by a thread. It’s really confusing for drivers and pedestrians, especially during rush hour.
The street sign at the corner of Broadway and 42nd is completely bent and hard to read. It’s putting pedestrians at risk because cars are slowing down trying to figure out where to go.

The sign at the corner of Maple Street and 20th Avenue is damaged and looks like it’s going to fall off any minute. I’ve seen several near-misses as cars miss the turn because they can’t see it clearly.
Can someone please fix the street sign on Elm Street? It’s been damaged for weeks, and it’s causing traffic to back up as people are unsure which way to go. This needs urgent attention!

label: Traffic Signal Condition. Veh Signal Head. Missing
complaints: I was driving down 5th Avenue and noticed that the traffic light at the intersection with 42nd Street is completely missing. It’s really dangerous for everyone trying to cross there, especially at rush hour.

I don’t know who to contact, but the pedestrian signal on 3rd Street near the park is gone. It's been like that for over a week now, and I'm worried kids playing in the area might not have safe crossing.
The traffic light at the corner of Broadway and 34th is missing! I almost had an accident trying to figure out if I could go or not. Can someone please address this ASAP?

I walk my dog every morning past the corner of 71st and Amsterdam, and the traffic signal has been missing for days. It’s hard to cross safely without it, and I’ve noticed a lot of cars speeding through the intersection.

label: Consumer Complaint. Restaurant. Receipt Inaccurate, Incomplete, or Not Given
complaints: I went to that new Italian place on 5th Avenue last night and when I got my check, it didn’t include the drinks we ordered. I had to go back to the counter to get it sorted out, which was super annoying. Why can’t they just get it right the first time?

I dined at a restaurant in the East Village last week and they didn’t give me a receipt after paying. I wanted to keep track of my expenses for budgeting purposes. Now I can’t remember how much I spent!

I ordered takeout from a Thai joint last Saturday and the receipt they gave me was missing several items that I actually paid for. I had to dispute the charge with my card company, which was a hassle. This needs to be fixed!

Last Friday at a diner in Brooklyn, the server didn’t provide a receipt after I paid with my credit card. I need it for my records, and I felt uncomfortable asking for one. It seems like they should just automatically provide it.

label: Street Light Condition. Street Light Lamp Missing. Location Type: Intersection
complaints: I'm calling to report that the street light at the corner of East 10th and 2nd Avenue is completely missing. It's been like this for at least two weeks now, and it's really dark when I'm walking home at night. I feel unsafe without that light.

The intersection of 3rd Street and 6th Avenue is incredibly dark because one of the streetlights is missing. I’ve noticed it gone for about a month now, and it’s making it difficult to cross safely, especially with all the traffic.
Could someone please do something about the missing street lamp at the corner of Broadway and 42nd? It’s been out for over a week and the area feels really sketchy after dark.

I just walked by the intersection of 5th Avenue and 14th Street, and there’s no street light at all where there should be one. It’s like a blackout zone, and I’m worried about people tripping or getting hit by cars.

label: Traffic Signal Condition. Post. Missing
complaints: I'm calling to report that the traffic signal at the corner of 5th Avenue and 42nd Street is completely missing. It’s been like this for over a week and drivers are confused, leading to some really close calls. It’s a busy intersection and we need that signal back ASAP!

There’s a traffic light post missing at the intersection of Broadway and 34th Street. It’s incredibly dangerous, especially during rush hour when cars are zooming by. This needs urgent attention before someone gets hurt!

I’ve noticed that the light at the intersection of 8th Street and 1st Avenue is gone. It’s been missing for about five days now, and I’m seeing lots of near accidents. Can someone please check on this?

The traffic signal on the corner of Park Avenue and 23rd Street has disappeared. It’s been a few days, and without it, pedestrians and drivers alike are at risk. It’s a busy area, so please get someone to replace it soon.

label: Street Light Condition. Lamppost Missing. Location Type: Intersection
complaints: I just walked through the intersection of 5th and Main, and all the street lights on that corner are out. It's pitch black at night, and I'm worried about safety. Can someone please fix that?
There's a lamppost missing at the corner of 42nd and 8th. This has been going on for weeks now, and it makes crossing the street really dangerous, especially after dark.

I noticed the street light at the intersection of Broadway and 23rd has been completely removed. It's been over a month, and it's so dark there, I can barely see anything when I walk home. This needs to be addressed urgently!

The lamppost at the corner of 15th and Avenue B has been down for a long time. It's hard to see, and I feel unsafe walking my dog there after sunset. Can we get some temporary lights or get this fixed?

label: Consumer Complaint. Drug Store or Pharmacy. Goods or Services Not Delivered
complaints: I ordered medication from my local pharmacy over a week ago and it still hasn't arrived. I rely on this medication daily, and this delay is really impacting my health. Can someone please follow up on this?

I'm really frustrated because I placed an online order for some essential items at my pharmacy, but it’s been three days and I haven’t heard anything. I need those supplies urgently. It’s unacceptable!
I was promised a delivery of a critical prescription yesterday, and it never came. I've been calling the pharmacy but can't get through. I really need this resolved soon!

This is ridiculous! I ordered my prescription to be delivered two weeks ago, and they keep saying it’s on the way. I’m almost out of my medication, and I’m at my wit's end here. Can someone do something about this?

label: Indoor Air Quality. Unsafe Mold Cleanup
complaints: I've been noticing a strong, musty smell in my apartment, especially after it rains, and I'm worried about the possibility of mold. I'm concerned for my health and need someone to check this out ASAP.

There are dark spots appearing on my walls and ceiling, and my allergies have been acting up worse than usual. It's been going on for weeks and I'm really anxious about the potential mold issue, please help!

I just moved into this unit a month ago, and I discovered mold growing under the bathroom sink. I called my landlord, but they haven't addressed it yet, and I can't live like this. Someone needs to come and take care of the problem immediately.

My bedroom is feeling damp all the time, and I found mold growing on the window frames. I've tried to clean it, but it keeps coming back. This has been an ongoing issue for over a month, and it's affecting my sleep and well-being.

label: Plumbing. Radiator. Missing Or Removed
complaints: I've noticed that the radiator in my apartment has been completely removed. It's getting really cold now that the seasons are changing, and I don't have any way to heat my place. Can someone please look into this?
My radiator has been missing for over a week after the maintenance team came to fix it. I can't believe how freezing my apartment has become, and I really need some heat before winter fully sets in.

There's a big problem in my unit—my radiator has disappeared! The last maintenance worker said they’d take a look, but that was days ago, and I'm not sure what to do in the meantime. This is just unacceptable with the temperature dropping.

I just wanted to report that my radiator is completely gone, and I’m really uncomfortable in my apartment. I called about this a few days ago, but still, no one has come to address the issue. It's getting urgent!

label: Consumer Complaint. Landlord or Real Estate Agent. Broker Fee Listed
complaints: I just signed a lease for an apartment and I didn’t realize there was a broker fee until after the fact. It feels really misleading because the listing didn’t mention it upfront, and now I’m stuck paying this extra cost I wasn’t prepared for.

I found an apartment I loved, but when I went to sign the lease, they suddenly added a hefty broker fee that wasn’t on the original listing. It feels unfair, and I wish I had known beforehand so I could have budgeted better.

I was looking at apartments and the broker told me there was no fee, but then tried to charge me one at the last minute. This feels like bait and switch tactics and I’m really frustrated with how deceptive this whole process has been.

The listing for my current apartment had no mention of a broker fee, but now that I’m moving in, I’m hit with this unexpected charge. It really feels like they’re taking advantage of people who are just trying to find a place to live.

label: Consumer Complaint. Clothing, Shoe, or Accessories Store. Advertising False or Misleading
complaints: I visited a store that advertised a big sale on shoes, but when I got there, the discounts were only on a very limited selection. I feel like I was misled into thinking I would find great deals.
I bought a jacket online because the website said it was 50% off, but when it arrived, I checked the tag and it was never on sale. This feels really dishonest and I'm quite frustrated.

I saw a flyer for a clothing shop that boasted about a major clearance event. When I got there, I found out the sale items were mostly out of stock and the prices were higher than advertised. It was a waste of time!

I ordered a pair of jeans based on the pictures and descriptions on the website, but what I received looked nothing like what was shown. The quality is poor, and I feel like I was tricked into purchasing.

label: Animal in a Park. Injured Wildlife. Bird
complaints: I was walking through Central Park near the Bethesda Fountain and noticed a bird on the ground that looked like it was injured. It was unable to fly and appeared to be struggling. I’m really worried about it and don’t know what to do.

There’s a hurt pigeon by the entrance of Prospect Park on the Flatbush side. I’ve seen it there for a few days now, and it doesn’t look good. Can someone come check on it? It's really concerning to see it suffer.
I just saw a sparrow lying on the path in Tompkins Square Park that seems to be in pain. It hasn’t moved for a while, and I think it might be hurt. Is there a way to get help for it?

Yesterday, I found an injured bird in Fort Greene Park. It was hiding in the bushes and couldn't fly. I tried to reach out to a few people, but no one knew how to help. This needs urgent attention before it gets worse.

label: General Construction/Plumbing. Illegal Conversion Of Commercial Bldg/Space To Other Uses
complaints: I've been noticing a lot of noise and construction during the early morning hours from the building across the street, and it seems like they're doing work that isn't permitted for a commercial space. It's really disruptive, and I'm concerned about how it impacts our neighborhood.

There's a bar on my block that’s suddenly doing extensive renovations and I suspect they're trying to turn it into apartments or something similar without proper permits. The construction has been going on for weeks and it feels really out of place in our area.

Can someone please look into the old storefront down the street? They've been working on it non-stop and it looks like they might be converting it into residential units. I thought that wasn't allowed in this zone. It's really frustrating and I worry about how it’ll change the community.

I live near a former retail space that has started heavy construction, but there's been no notice or any sign of what they're doing. It’s been a month of noise and confusion, and I’m really worried they’re not following the regulations set for commercial properties.

label: School Maintenance. Rodents/Mice. Rodents Seen
complaints: I can't believe there are mice running around the hallways at my child's school. It's disgusting and makes me worried about their health. This needs to be fixed immediately!

I've been hearing reports from my neighbors that there are mice in the classrooms at the school down the block. I saw one myself yesterday, and it’s unacceptable. My kids deserve a safe environment to learn in.
For weeks now my child’s school has had a rodent problem. I’m really concerned about the cleanliness and safety of the place. Can someone please address this issue?
There are mice everywhere in the cafeteria of the school. I saw one scurry across the floor while my kids were eating lunch! This is really not okay, and something must be done ASAP.

label: Lost Property. Bag/Wallet. Shopping Bag
complaints: I was at the grocery store on 45th Avenue around 6 PM yesterday, and I accidentally left my reusable shopping bag behind. It has my favorite cloth bags and a few items I just bought, and I'm really hoping someone has turned it in.

I lost my shopping bag on the subway this morning, I was on the Q train heading towards Brooklyn. It had my lunch and a couple of gifts for a friend’s birthday. If anyone finds it, I'd appreciate it if they could let me know!

I was at the park near 3rd Street yesterday afternoon and left my reusable shopping bag on one of the benches. It has some fruits and snacks inside. I really need those items back, so if anyone sees it, please reach out!

I went to the flea market last weekend and somehow misplaced my shopping bag filled with handmade goods. It was a unique bag, and I’m really upset about losing it. If you happen to find something like that, please let me know.

label: Traffic Signal Condition. Ver Mesage Sign RTPI. Operating Improperly
complaints: I just wanted to report that the traffic signal at 5th Avenue and 42nd Street is malfunctioning. It keeps flashing yellow at random times, causing a lot of confusion for drivers and pedestrians alike. It's been doing this for about a week now.

Can someone please look into the traffic lights at the intersection of Broadway and 34th Street? The lights are out of sync, and I almost got hit by a car when I thought it was safe to cross. This has been a problem for days; it’s really dangerous!

The message sign on the corner of 10th Avenue and 23rd Street isn’t working. It’s been showing the same outdated information for a month, and it’s really frustrating when trying to navigate around the construction happening in the area. Please fix it soon!

I live right near the traffic lights at 8th Avenue and 14th Street, and they’re not functioning properly. Cars often run red lights because the signal stays green way too long. This has been happening for over two weeks now and it’s getting increasingly dangerous.

label: Street Light Condition. Lamppost Wire Exposed. Location Type: Highway
complaints: I was driving down the highway last night and noticed that a lamppost has an exposed wire hanging out. It's really dangerous, especially if someone were to accidentally touch it or if it gets wet. Please get it fixed soon!

There’s an exposed wire on one of the lampposts along the highway near exit 12. It’s been like that for a week now and I’m really worried someone might get hurt—especially with all the rain we've been having. Can someone look into this?

I saw an exposed wire on a streetlight while I was stuck in traffic on the highway this morning. It’s clearly a safety hazard and could cause a serious accident if someone walks by it. It needs urgent attention!

Driving home last night, I spotted a lamppost with a wire hanging loose on the highway. I can’t believe it hasn’t been addressed yet. It’s a potential shock hazard and a real concern for everyone passing by. Please send someone to check this out.

label: Street Light Condition. Lamppost Base Door/Cover Open. Location Type: Intersection
complaints: The lamppost at the corner of 5th and Main has its base cover open, and it's been like this for a few days now. It's a safety hazard, especially at night when it gets dark. Can someone please check it out?
I noticed that the light post at 42nd and Broadway has an open base door. It's been that way for over a week, and I'm worried someone might trip or hurt themselves. It really needs to be fixed soon!

There's an open cover on the lamppost at the intersection of 10th and 48th. I walk by there every evening, and it worries me. It seems like a dangerous situation with wires exposed. This needs urgent attention!

I was walking my dog at the corner of 12th and 34th last night and saw that the base of the streetlight is wide open. I can't believe that's been allowed to stay like that, especially with kids around. Please send someone to secure it.

label: Consumer Complaint. Storage Warehouse. Contract or Billing Dispute
complaints: I recently noticed an extra charge on my storage bill that I never agreed to. I've contacted the facility twice, but no one seems to have an answer. I'm really frustrated and just want to resolve this ASAP.

I’ve been trying to get my stuff out of the storage unit since last week, but the office has been closed every time I go. It’s really frustrating—they should have better hours or at least some way to access my belongings.
I signed a contract for a certain rate, but my latest invoice shows a price hike without any explanation. I feel scammed and nobody is returning my calls. Can someone please help me sort this out?
I put my things in a storage unit a month ago and now they’re charging me for services I didn’t ask for. I’ve emailed customer service many times, but no one responds. This is unacceptable!

label: Bus Stop Shelter Placement. New Bus Stop Shelter Placement
complaints: I just noticed that the new bus stop shelter was put up right in front of my apartment building, and it blocks my view and makes it difficult to get in and out. I wish they would have considered the impact on residents before placing it here.

I’m really frustrated that the city decided to put a bus stop shelter in such a cramped space on my block. It’s already a busy area and now it’s even harder to navigate with the added congestion from people waiting for the bus.

Why was the new bus shelter placed on this street? It’s so narrow that it forces pedestrians into traffic, and it’s a safety hazard. My kids walk by here every day, and I’m worried about their safety.

I appreciate having a bus shelter, but placing it right next to the intersection has created a huge backup during rush hour. Cars are constantly honking and it’s very loud; it’s become unbearable to live here.

label: Overgrown Tree/Branches. Hitting Phone/Cable Lines. Other Types of Wires
complaints: There's a tree in front of my building that has branches hanging dangerously close to the utility lines. I’m worried that they might get damaged during the next storm, and it’s been like this for weeks.

I’ve noticed that the branches of a tree on my street are brushing against the power lines every time the wind blows. This happens mainly in the evenings, and it’s really concerning since we rely heavily on our internet for work.

The overgrown tree in front of my house is starting to block the neighbor's satellite dish and it’s also tangled with the phone lines. This has been a problem for over a month now, and it’s affecting our service.

I’ve been meaning to report the tree on my corner that’s leaning over the street. Its branches are right near the cable wires, and it's becoming a real hazard, especially during heavy rain. Can someone come out and take care of this?

label: School Maintenance. Heating Problem. No Heat
complaints: It's freezing in my child's classroom and the heating hasn't worked for days. They have to wear their coats inside, which is unacceptable. Can someone please address this issue?

I just dropped off my kids at school and noticed that the heating system is down. The temperature in the classrooms is unbearable, and it's been like this since last week. Please do something about it.
My son came home from school complaining that they had no heat all day, and it's only going to get colder. This is the third day in a row! We need some urgency on fixing this problem.
I called the school about the heat not working, but they say they are waiting on repairs. My daughter can't focus in class because it's so cold. This issue should have been resolved by now.

label: Industrial Waste. Concrete In Catch Basin (IEA). Iea
complaints: There's a concrete slab stuck in the catch basin on my street, and it’s causing water to pool during rainstorms. This has been happening for over a week now, and I’m worried about it attracting mosquitoes or causing damage to the road.

I live near the intersection of 5th and Main, and the catch basin is filled with concrete debris. It’s been like this for days—every time it rains, the street floods, and it's a real mess for drivers and pedestrians.
Could someone please check the catch basin on 10th Avenue? It’s clogged with concrete, and during the last storm, it caused some serious flooding on our block. This has got to be fixed soon!

I've noticed that the catch basin at the corner of 14th and Broadway hasn’t been working properly. There’s a significant amount of concrete in it that’s preventing drainage and making it really unsafe for cars and people when it rains. It’s been like this for about a week.

label: New Tree Request. For One Address. Street Tree
complaints: I live on 3rd Avenue and there are no trees along our block. It gets really hot in the summer, and I think adding some trees would help cool things down and make it more pleasant for everyone.
I’m calling to request a new tree in front of my building on 5th Street. It’s such a bare area, and I believe a tree would enhance the neighborhood and provide some much-needed shade.
There’s a long stretch on 7th Avenue without any trees, and it feels so stark and uninviting. We could really use a few to liven up the street and provide some greenery for residents.

I’ve noticed that the area around Broadway and 10th Street is completely lacking trees. I think it would benefit the environment and beautify our block if we could plant some new ones as soon as possible.

label: Street Sign - Damaged. One Way
complaints: The one-way sign on 5th Avenue near the corner of 45th Street is completely mangled and hard to read. I saw a driver going the wrong way yesterday, and it scared me to think they didn't see it. Can someone please fix this?

I live on Maple Street and there’s a one-way sign that has been knocked over for at least a week now. Cars keep coming down our side, and it's only a matter of time before there's an accident. This needs urgent attention!

Could someone please check on the one-way sign at the intersection of Broadway and 34th? It's bent at an awkward angle, and I've noticed several drivers ignoring it. It’s been like this for days, and I’m worried about potential collisions.

There’s a damaged one-way sign at the corner of 10th and 22nd. It's barely visible because it's leaning and covered in graffiti. I travel this route daily, and I've seen a couple of near misses because of it. It really needs to be replaced, like, yesterday!

label: Street Sign - Missing. Street Cleaning - ASP
complaints: I just drove down 5th Avenue and noticed that the street sign at 34th Street is missing. It made it really confusing for me and others trying to navigate the area. Can someone please replace it?

I live on 10th Street, and I’ve noticed that the street cleaning signs were taken down weeks ago. It's been a nightmare with the garbage piling up, especially with all the rain lately. We really need those signs back!
There’s a missing stop sign at the corner of Maple and Pine. It’s very dangerous, especially with kids around. People are flying through that intersection without slowing down—please fix this ASAP.

I live near a park and the street cleaning sign on my block has been gone for over a month. The streets are looking really dirty and it’s hard to find parking because no one knows when cleaning is scheduled. Can you put a new sign up?

label: Cannabis Retailer. Product Concerns
complaints: I bought some edibles from a shop downtown, and they didn't have any dosage information on the packaging. It's really concerning because I have no idea how much I should take or what to expect.
I purchased a pre-rolled joint yesterday, and it tasted completely off. I'm not sure if it was old or improperly stored, but it definitely didn't feel safe to smoke. Can someone please look into it?

I recently tried a new strain from one of the local retailers and had a terrible experience. It was way stronger than advertised, and I ended up feeling paranoid for hours. It’s not only unpleasant but could potentially be dangerous for others.

I noticed that some products in a nearby cannabis shop don't have the proper lab testing information displayed. With so many consumers relying on these products, how can we be sure they're safe? It's really worrying.

label: Obstruction. Trash or Recycling. Containers Chained to Public Property
complaints: There’s a recycling bin that has been chained to the lamppost on my corner for weeks now. It’s taking up valuable sidewalk space and makes it difficult to navigate, especially with kids in strollers.

Every time I walk by the park on 5th Avenue, I see a trash can that’s been locked up and pushed into the middle of the walkway. It’s really frustrating because it forces people to walk around it, and it’s causing congestion during rush hour.
I don’t understand why the garbage cans near my apartment are always tethered to signs. It makes them hard to access and they're frequently overflowing. Can someone please take a look?
The recycling bins around my block are chained down and it’s inconvenient – I can barely fit my bags in without climbing over other trash. It’s driving me crazy during my morning commute!

label: Day Care. Day Care Facility. Illegal Day Care
complaints: I just moved into the neighborhood and noticed a day care operating out of a residential apartment. It's very loud during the day, and the kids are often outside playing without adult supervision. I’m worried about their safety and the noise is becoming unbearable.

There’s a place on my block that claims to be a day care, but it doesn’t seem licensed. I see way too many kids being dropped off and picked up at odd hours and it looks chaotic. Can someone please check if they're running a legal operation?

I can’t believe how disruptive this illegal day care is! They start making noise at 7 AM and it continues throughout the day. I’m concerned about the lack of proper facilities for these kids, too. This isn’t just an inconvenience; it feels unsafe.

I see a lot of children being cared for in a small apartment nearby. I’m worried about the safety of those kids since it looks overcrowded, and there are no outdoor play areas. It feels like it’s affecting our quality of life in the neighborhood.

label: Traffic Signal Condition. Base Door. Open
complaints: I've noticed that the traffic signal at the corner of 5th and Main has been stuck on red for over 30 minutes now. Cars are getting frustrated and it's causing a backup. Can someone please check it out?

There's a traffic light on Broadway that seems to be malfunctioning. It goes from green to red without any warning, and it’s really dangerous for pedestrians. This has been happening for a few days and I’m worried someone might get hurt.
The traffic signal at 42nd Street and 7th Avenue is completely out! Drivers are just going through the intersection without stopping, and it's causing a chaotic scene. Can you send someone to fix it?

I've been waiting at the light on Park Avenue for what feels like forever, and I just saw it turn red again while there was no traffic on the cross street. It’s so frustrating and dangerous when people don’t know when to go!

label: Violation of Park Rules. Obstructing Public Use. Playground Equipment
complaints: I just wanted to take my kids to the playground on 5th Street, but there’s a bunch of construction equipment blocking the entrance. It’s been like this for days, and my kids can't even play!

There’s a large pile of trash near the sandbox in the park by my building. It’s been there for more than a week, and it’s attracting rats. My kids won’t even go near that area anymore. Something needs to be done about it!

complaints: I parked my car at the garage on 42nd Street yesterday, and when I went to pay, they charged me $50 for just four hours! That’s way too high compared to what I’ve seen at other places.

complaints: The handrail on the stairs in my building is loose and shakes whenever I grab it. I’m worried it might give out completely, especially since I use those stairs every day. Can someone please take a look as soon as possible?

The banister in my stairwell is barely attached and it makes it difficult to feel secure going up and down the stairs. I live on the fifth floor, and I can’t imagine what would happen if it gave way while someone was using it. This needs urgent attention!

I’ve been meaning to report that the handrail on the stairs is completely loose. I nearly fell yesterday trying to steady myself as I went down. It’s becoming a real hazard for everyone in the building. Please send someone to fix it right away.

label: Outdoor Dining. Restaurant Status. Unauthorized
complaints: I live near 15th Street and 7th Avenue, and that restaurant has set up outdoor seating that spills into the sidewalk so much I can barely walk past with my stroller. It’s been like this for weeks and it’s really frustrating.

I don’t mind outdoor dining, but the dining area at the bistro on 3rd Avenue has become so noisy and crowded that it feels like I have people eating on my front porch! Can’t they keep it limited to their property?

Why is that cafe on 9th Street allowed to have their outdoor tables blocking the entrance to my building? I have to squeeze past them every time I come and go. This is really unacceptable and it’s been like this for days.

label: Consumer Complaint. Other Store (Non-Food). Goods or Services Not Delivered
complaints: I ordered a new couch from that store two weeks ago and it was supposed to arrive yesterday. I've called three times and no one seems to know where it is. This is getting ridiculous.

I placed an order for a set of kitchen appliances online and paid for expedited shipping. They were supposed to be delivered on Monday, but here I am on Thursday and I still haven't received anything. What is going on?

I bought a new smartphone from a local shop, and they said it would be ready for pickup last week. When I went in, they told me it hasn’t arrived yet and could take another week. I really need my phone!

I signed up for a subscription service that promised to deliver monthly beauty products, but I haven't received anything in over a month. I've emailed and called for updates, but no one is responding. This is so frustrating!

label: Consumer Complaint. Tow Truck Company. Billing Dispute
complaints: I had my car towed last week from a legal parking spot, and when I called the towing company to dispute the charges, they were incredibly rude and refused to listen to my explanation. I feel like I'm being taken advantage of and just want to resolve this fairly.

I was charged an outrageous fee after my car was towed, and I believe the amount is higher than what was stated on their website. I tried contacting them for clarification, but nobody seems to be willing to help me sort this out.

After getting my car towed, I went to pick it up and was stunned by the bill. It was almost triple what I expected it to be. I feel this is completely unjust, and I want to lodge a formal complaint against their pricing practices.

I paid a hefty towing fee last month, and now I've received a threatening letter saying I owe even more money due to 'storage fees.' I never received any prior notice, and it feels like they're just trying to squeeze more money out of me. This is so frustrating!

label: Traffic Signal Condition. Controller Cabinet. Operating Improperly
complaints: The traffic light at 5th Avenue and 42nd Street has been malfunctioning for days. It's stuck on red for too long, and cars are getting frustrated and blocking intersections. Can someone please check it out?

I’ve noticed that the traffic signal at the corner of 34th Street and 8th Avenue is changing erratically. This is causing a lot of confusion and potential accidents; it needs immediate attention before someone gets hurt.

The light at Broadway and 14th Street has been blinking yellow for the past three days. Drivers are totally disregarding it, and it’s creating a dangerous situation for pedestrians trying to cross. We need a fix, ASAP!

Could you send someone to look at the traffic light at the intersection of Houston and Lafayette? It’s completely out, and traffic is a mess; I can't believe how chaotic it has been, especially during rush hour.

label: Consumer Complaint. Supermarket or Grocery Store. Price Not Posted or Inaccurate
complaints: I just came back from the grocery store on 2nd Avenue and noticed that several items didn’t have prices posted on the shelves. I ended up paying way more than I expected at the register. This has happened a few times now and it's really frustrating!

I bought some pasta at the store on Broadway yesterday, and when I got to the checkout, the price was $2 higher than what was labeled on the shelf. It's not the first time this has happened to me, and it's really starting to get on my nerves.

I was shopping last night and saw some yogurt that was marked as on sale, but when I checked out, it rang up at the regular price. I pointed it out to the cashier, and they just shrugged. Can’t they keep their pricing straight?

I recently visited the deli section of my local supermarket and noticed that the prices on the wall don’t match what rings up at the register. I had to ask for a price check for a couple of items, which delayed my shopping experience. This inconsistency has been occurring too frequently.

label: Consumer Complaint. Supermarket or Grocery Store. Advertising False or Misleading
complaints: I bought a pack of organic strawberries at the supermarket, but when I got home, the expiration date was the next day! They were advertised as fresh and perfect, but they were definitely past their prime. I feel misled and wasted my money.

I saw a big sale sign for a certain brand of pasta in the store and when I got to the register, it rang up at full price. When I went back to show them the sign, they said they had run out and I was out of luck. It's frustrating to see misleading promotions like this.

I recently purchased a so-called 'family pack' of chicken breasts, but it was the exact same amount as the regular pack, just in a bigger container. It’s disappointing to be tricked into thinking I was getting more for my money. This kind of advertising isn’t right.

I picked up a box of cereal that claimed to be 'healthier' with added vitamins, yet when I checked the back, it was loaded with sugar and empty calories. I feel like the labeling is intentionally misleading and not at all what I expected.

label: Animal in a Park. Injured Wildlife. Raccoon
complaints: I spotted a raccoon in Prospect Park that looks really hurt. Its leg seems injured, and it's just sitting there by the edge of the trail. I’m worried for its safety and the safety of other park visitors. Can someone check on it?

There’s a raccoon in Central Park that appears to be limping and is clearly in distress. It’s been there for over an hour now, and I don’t think it can fend for itself. It’s not safe for people or the animal; please send someone to help.

I saw an injured raccoon near the pond in Fort Tryon Park yesterday. It looked like it was in pain and couldn't move properly. I tried to call animal services, but I’m not sure if anyone is coming. This poor creature needs urgent attention, and it’s upsetting to see it like that.

In Bryant Park, there is a raccoon that seems to be in trouble. It’s not moving much, and it’s been there since this morning. I'm really concerned that it might not survive if someone doesn’t assist it soon. It’s important we help wildlife in our parks!

label: Consumer Complaint. Supermarket or Grocery Store. Overcharge
complaints: I was at my local grocery store yesterday, and I noticed that I was charged twice for a single item. I had to argue with the cashier for several minutes before they finally agreed to refund me. This is just so frustrating and it's happened to me before!

I bought a pack of pasta that was marked on sale, but when I checked my receipt, I was charged full price. It’s a real hassle to go back and get this sorted out, especially since I live a good distance away from the store.

Last week, I went to buy some fruits and vegetables, and when I checked out, the cashier rang up my items incorrectly. I ended up paying way more than I should have. I had to ask for a manager to fix it, and it wasted a lot of my time. It's disappointing that this keeps happening.

I went to the supermarket this morning and saw that my favorite cereal was on sale. However, when I got to the register, they charged me the regular price. I had to bring it to their attention, and it just shouldn’t be this hard to get a fair price.

label: Street Sign - Missing. Yield
complaints: I'm calling to report a serious issue on Maple Avenue where the yield sign has been missing for over a week. Drivers are zooming through that intersection, and I'm worried someone is going to get hurt if it's not replaced soon.

There's a missing yield sign at the corner of 5th and Main. I've noticed cars speeding through there without slowing down, and I've almost been hit twice while crossing the street with my kids. Can someone please take care of this?

I live near the intersection of Cedar and 12th, and the yield sign has been gone for over a month now. It's causing confusion for drivers, and I've seen several near misses. This is getting out of hand!

Can you please look into the missing yield sign at the intersection of 14th and Broadway? It disappeared a few weeks ago, and ever since, I've seen so many close calls. I really think it needs urgent attention!

label: Illegal Parking. Parking Permit Improper Use. Parked In Bus Lane
complaints: I can't believe it! There’s a car parked in the bus lane right outside my apartment on 42nd Street. Buses are getting delayed, and it’s just a nightmare during rush hour. This has been going on for the last thirty minutes!
There’s a vehicle parked in the bus lane on Broadway and 8th Avenue. I’ve seen multiple buses getting stuck behind it, and it’s only making traffic worse. It’s been here since this morning!

The bus lane on 14th Street is blocked by a parked car, which is incredibly frustrating. I rely on the bus to get to work, and it’s consistently late because of this. It’s been happening regularly in the past week!
I’m fed up! There’s a car in the bus lane on 5th Avenue near the park. It’s been there for over an hour now, and buses are having to swerve around it. Can someone please do something about this?

complaints: The lane markings on the FDR Drive are barely visible, especially at night. It’s really dangerous trying to navigate through the lanes when I can't see where I'm supposed to be. This needs to be addressed before someone gets in an accident.

I drive down the West Side Highway every morning, and the marks on the road are so faded that I have to guess which lane I’m in. Could you please send someone to repaint them? It’s been like this for weeks now!
I noticed that the road lines on the Brooklyn-Queens Expressway are in terrible shape. It's hard to stay in my lane when the lines are so worn out. Please do something about this soon!
The exit markings on the Queensboro Bridge are almost completely gone. I don’t know how drivers are expected to know where to go. This has been a problem for months and just keeps getting worse.

label: Lost Property. Electronics/Phones. Camera
complaints: I lost my camera while walking around Central Park yesterday afternoon. I think I left it on a bench near the Bethesda Terrace, and I’m really hoping someone turned it in.

My camera was stolen from my bag while I was at a coffee shop in Brooklyn. I had just set it down for a moment, and when I looked back, it was gone. I’m really upset about it and hope someone can help me recover it.

complaints: I frequently walk through the plaza at 5th Avenue and it's been taken over by construction equipment and illegal vendor setups. I can't even find a bench to sit on anymore, and it’s been like this for weeks. Can someone please look into this?

The seating area in the courtyard on 6th Avenue isn’t accessible anymore because of some fencing that’s been up for more than two weeks. I used to enjoy eating my lunch there, but now it's just a mess. Can someone check on when this will be cleared up?

The sprinklers in my local playground aren’t doing their job. Children often play there when it gets hot, and without proper watering, the area is just a dusty mess. This has been ongoing for a while now.

There’s a urinal in the public restroom of my building that has been running non-stop for days. It’s so loud, and I can’t imagine how much water it’s wasting. Please send someone to fix it, it's really annoying.

I’ve got a malfunctioning flushometer in my bathroom that won’t stop running. It’s been like this for over a week now, and I can hear it throughout the apartment. It’s such a waste, and I really need it fixed soon.

label: Flooring/Stairs. Stairs. Stair Covering Torn Or Missing

complaints: The drinking fountain in Central Park near the playground has been out of order for over a week now. It's really frustrating, especially with so many kids playing in the area and no nearby options for water.
