The drinking fountain at Washington Square Park has been leaking for days, and it’s creating quite a mess. I’m worried about the slipping hazard, especially with so many people walking around.
I live near Astoria Park, and the fountain next to the tennis courts hasn't been working for the last two weeks. It's disappointing because we rely on it to stay hydrated while playing outdoors.

label: Water Maintenance. Fire Hydrant Leaning/Missing
complaints: I noticed that the fire hydrant at the corner of 5th Avenue and 42nd Street is leaning quite a bit. It seems unstable, and I’m worried it might fall over if someone bumps into it. Could someone please check it out?

There’s a fire hydrant on Park Avenue that’s missing completely! I don't know how long it's been gone, but it makes me nervous, especially with all the construction happening around here. We need that hydrant for safety.
The fire hydrant on 8th Street in the West Village is leaning so much it looks like it might topple over. I’ve seen kids playing nearby, and it’s a serious hazard. Can someone come and take a look?

I just wanted to report that the fire hydrant by the subway entrance on 23rd is leaning alarmingly. It’s been this way for at least a week, and I'm concerned it could create a dangerous situation if there’s ever a fire.

label: Street Sign - Dangling. Do Not Enter
complaints: There's a dangling Do Not Enter sign on the corner of 5th and Main. I worry it might fall and hit someone if it’s not fixed soon. It's been like this for over a week now.
I noticed the Do Not Enter sign at the intersection of 42nd and 8th has been hanging by a thread for days. Drivers are ignoring it, and it's causing some dangerous situations during rush hour.
The Do Not Enter sign at 77th and Broadway is hanging down almost to the ground. It's hard to see, and I can already tell it's confusing drivers. This has been going on for several days now.
Please check the Do Not Enter sign on 23rd Street near the park. It's dangling and looks like it's about to fall off. I've seen cars go through there that shouldn’t, and it's getting dangerous.

label: Animal-Abuse. In Car. Other
complaints: I just saw a dog left in a locked car on 5th Avenue with the windows barely cracked. It’s sweltering outside, and it looks like the poor thing is struggling to breathe. Someone needs to check on it before it gets hurt!

There’s a little puppy in a car parked on Broadway, and it’s been there for over an hour. The temperature inside must be unbearable. I’m really worried about its safety and well-being, can someone please do something?
I cannot believe the dog I saw in a vehicle near Central Park. It’s been in there for at least 30 minutes, panting heavily in this heat. I don’t know what else to do but call for help!

I’m extremely concerned about a cat that’s been left alone in a parked car around Times Square for over 45 minutes now. The sun is blazing, and I’m afraid it could suffer from heatstroke if no one intervenes soon.

label: Safety. Fire Escape. Rusted Or Peeling
complaints: I'm calling because the fire escape outside my apartment on 5th Street is in really bad shape. The paint is peeling and I'm worried it might become a safety hazard, especially during an emergency. Can someone please come take a look?

The fire escape on my building in the East Village looks like it hasn't been maintained in years. There’s rust all over it, and I’m concerned about how safe it is. I haven't seen anyone check it in a long time.
I live on the 3rd floor, and the fire escape is covered in rust and peeling paint. With the winter coming, I'm really worried it will deteriorate further. This needs urgent attention.

The fire escape at my apartment on Lexington Avenue is falling apart. The rusted metal and chipped paint are not just an eyesore; they could be dangerous if I ever need to use it. Please send someone to inspect it as soon as possible.

label: Animal in a Park. Injured Wildlife. Duck
complaints: I was at Central Park today and I saw a duck that looked injured. It was having trouble walking and seemed to be in pain. Can someone please check on it?
There’s a wounded duck in Prospect Park near the lake. It’s been there for over an hour, and it’s not moving much. I’m really worried about it and hope someone can help soon.

I don’t know who to call, but there’s a duck in the park that’s limping badly. It’s just lying there, and it doesn’t look good. I’ve tried to keep kids away from it, but it needs assistance right away.

I spotted an injured duck at Flushing Meadows park around noon. It was just sitting by the water and not able to take off. It’s been like that for at least two hours. Someone should do something before it gets worse.

label: Safety. Sprinkler. Sprinkler Missing
complaints: I've noticed that the sprinkler in the park on 14th Street is missing. With the heatwave we're experiencing, it's really disappointing for the kids who play there because it used to be a perfect spot to cool down. Can someone please look into replacing it?

I live near the community center on 5th Avenue, and the sprinkler system has been completely removed. It's been this way for over a month now, and with summer in full swing, it would be great to have it back. We really need a safe way to cool off in this heat.

Could someone please check on the missing sprinkler at James Madison Park? It seems to have vanished recently, and without it, the grass is drying out and kids are left without a way to stay cool. This is becoming a real issue!

The sprinkler that used to run in the playground at Riverside Park isn't working anymore. It seems to have been taken out, and now the area feels so dry and dusty. It would really help the neighborhood if we could get that fixed before it gets any hotter.

label: Consumer Complaint. Used Car Dealer. Unlicensed
complaints: I bought a used car from a dealer on the corner of 5th Street last month, and it broke down just two days later. They promised a warranty but now they're unresponsive. I feel scammed and want something done about it.

I reported a used car dealer operating without a license on Elm Avenue weeks ago, but nothing seems to have changed. People are still being taken advantage of, and I'm worried about my neighbors falling victim too.

I purchased a car from a local dealer who turned out to be unlicensed. It has been a nightmare trying to get my money back. I've called them multiple times, but they just keep dodging my calls. This needs to be addressed!

There’s a sketchy used car lot near my apartment that I suspect is not licensed. The cars look like they’ve been in accidents, and I overheard someone from there talking about selling a faulty vehicle. I just want to make sure this place gets shut down.

label: Food Establishment. Food Temperature. Food Raw/Undercooked
complaints: I ordered a medium-rare burger from that new place on 5th Avenue, but when I took a bite, it was practically raw inside. I couldn't eat it, and I felt really uneasy afterwards. Something needs to be done about their food safety.
I got takeout from a local diner last night, and the chicken was completely undercooked. I could see it was still pink in the middle. I’m worried that if I hadn’t noticed, it could have made me sick.

I visited a restaurant in Brooklyn last weekend, and the steak I received was served cold and rare, despite ordering it well-done. This isn't just a preference issue; it's unsafe! I couldn’t even finish the meal because I was so concerned about getting sick.

My husband and I went to a popular spot downtown last night, and the fish we were served was not cooked all the way through. We didn't want to get food poisoning, so we told the waiter, but he just shrugged it off. It's unacceptable!

label: Traffic Signal Condition. Veh Signal Visor. Damaged
complaints: I've been driving through the intersection at 42nd and 8th and the traffic light visor is completely bent. It's hard to see if it's red or green during the day and I feel like it's a serious safety hazard.
Can someone please fix the traffic signal at 14th and 6th? The visor is damaged and doesn't block the sun at all; I almost missed a red light today because I couldn't see it clearly!

I’m really frustrated with the traffic signal at Broadway and 34th. The visor is damaged, and it makes it impossible to tell whether the light is working. I had to stop suddenly today because of it, and that's not safe for anyone.
Every time I stop at the light on 23rd and Madison, I struggle to see the signal because the visor is all messed up. It’s been like this for over a week now—can someone please take a look?

label: Street Sign - Damaged. Construction
complaints: I was walking down 5th Avenue and noticed that the street sign at the intersection with 42nd Street is completely bent and hard to read. It’s been like that for over a week now, and I’m worried someone might get hurt trying to figure out which way to go.

The construction on 6th Street has knocked down the stop sign at the corner of Maple, and it’s been missing for days. Cars are flying through that intersection without stopping, and it’s terrifying to cross!

I've been seeing the same damaged street sign at the corner of East 70th and 1st Avenue for two weeks, and it’s not just unsightly; it’s causing confusion for drivers and pedestrians. Can someone please fix it?

There’s a construction site on Broadway, and the street sign indicating the one-way has been knocked down for days now. I’ve nearly witnessed a few close calls with drivers who are clearly confused. This needs to be addressed ASAP.

label: Litter Basket Complaint. Misuse. Used for Household Trash
complaints: I just walked past the litter basket outside my building and it’s overflowing with household trash. This happens all the time and it’s disgusting, plus it attracts rats! People need to use their own bins.

The garbage can on the corner of 5th Avenue and 10th Street is being used as a personal trash can. I saw someone throwing in boxes and bags from their apartment. It’s a mess and it ruins the whole area.

Can you please do something about the public litter bins? The one near the park is constantly filled with junk like pizza boxes and bags of trash from people’s homes. It’s embarrassing and makes it hard to enjoy the area.
This morning I saw someone dumping their garbage into the street litter basket instead of taking it home. It’s been overflowing for days and it’s really gross. Can’t we get more enforcement on this?

label: Residential Disposal Complaint. Refrigerator or Freezer Door Attached
complaints: I just noticed that there's an old refrigerator sitting outside my building, and the door's still attached. I'm worried that it's going to attract kids or animals. Can someone please come and take it away?

There’s an abandoned freezer in front of my building with the door wide open. It’s been there for two days and it’s really dangerous, especially with kids playing around. It needs to be removed as soon as possible!

I live on 3rd Avenue and there’s a fridge just sitting on the sidewalk with the door still on it. It’s been there for a week now and it’s starting to smell bad, plus I’m concerned about safety. Can this be taken care of?

There’s an old refrigerator left out by the curb near my apartment. It has the door attached and it’s been there for several days. I’m worried someone might get hurt if they open it up. Please send someone to pick it up!

label: Overgrown Tree/Branches. Traffic Sign or Signal Blocked. Sign
complaints: There’s a huge tree on the corner of 5th and Main that’s blocking the stop sign completely. I almost missed it while driving this morning because the branches are so overgrown. Something needs to be done before someone gets hurt!

I live on Elm Street, and the branches from the big oak in front of my building are hanging so low that they’re obstructing the view of the traffic light. It’s been like this for weeks, and it’s really dangerous for drivers trying to make a turn.

I noticed that the tree outside my apartment is so massive that it’s completely hiding the street sign. I’ve seen a few confused drivers miss the turn because they can’t see it. Can someone please trim those branches?

Every time I drive down Maple Avenue, I have to dodge this low-hanging branch from a tree that’s blocking a stop sign. This has been an issue for months now, and it’s only a matter of time before it causes a serious accident.

label: Consumer Complaint. Restaurant. Price Gouging
complaints: I just ordered takeout from a local spot and was shocked to find they raised their prices by nearly 30% overnight. I understand that times are tough, but this feels like price gouging and it's making it hard for me to afford my meals.

I went to my favorite deli yesterday and saw they jacked up the prices on everything. A sandwich that used to be $8 is now $12! I can't believe how greedy they are being, especially when people are struggling.

After visiting a restaurant downtown, I couldn't believe the bill. My friend and I shared a few appetizers, and we ended up paying over $50! The prices are outrageous; I feel like I'm being taken advantage of. Something needs to be done about this.

I used to love my local café, but recently their prices have gone through the roof. A simple coffee and muffin that cost me $5 last year is now over $10. It's ridiculous; I can't keep supporting a place that doesn't care about its customers.

label: Consumer Complaint. Other Store (Non-Food). Cash Payment Not Accepted
complaints: I went to the corner store on 5th Avenue yesterday, and they refused to accept cash. This is ridiculous! How can a business not take cash when so many people rely on it?

Yesterday, I tried to buy some basic supplies at a local shop, but they only accepted credit cards. I was frustrated because I didn't have my card on me and it’s really inconvenient for those of us who prefer using cash.
I visited a store on 8th Street and was shocked when they told me they don’t accept cash payments anymore. It’s really unfair for people who don’t use cards. Can’t believe this is how it’s going now.

I attempted to make a purchase at a shop in Harlem this morning, but they refused my cash payment. I understand there are changes happening, but cash is still legal tender and should be accepted everywhere.

label: Consumer Complaint. Landlord or Real Estate Agent. Fees or Surcharges Not Disclosed
complaints: I just moved into my new apartment and was shocked to find out about all these hidden fees for amenities that my landlord never mentioned during the lease signing. It's frustrating to feel misled after already committing to the place.

When I signed my lease, I was told my rent included all utilities. Now I’m getting charged extra for things like trash and maintenance that weren’t disclosed. It feels like I'm being taken advantage of.
I was promised a specific rent amount, but after I signed the lease, I discovered there are additional charges for things like common area maintenance. This should have been disclosed beforehand!
I was excited about my new apartment, but after moving in, I found out there are surprise fees that weren’t mentioned during the negotiation. I feel like I can’t trust my landlord to be honest.

label: Consumer Complaint. Debt Collection Agency. Harassment
complaints: I've been getting repeated calls from a debt collection agency, even though I have already told them I don't owe anything. They call multiple times a day, and it's really stressing me out.
A debt collector keeps calling me at all hours, including late at night. I've asked them to stop, but they just won't listen. It's getting so frustrating!
I received a letter from a collection agency about a debt I don’t owe, and now they’re calling me nonstop. It’s really annoying, and I just want them to stop harassing me.

I'm being bombarded with phone calls from a debt collector about a supposed debt. I've never heard of it, and despite my attempts to resolve it, they keep calling me every day. It's starting to interfere with my work.

label: Maintenance or Facility. Structure - Outdoors. Hard Court Surface/Equipment
complaints: The basketball court at the park on 5th Avenue is in terrible shape. The surface is cracking and uneven, making it hard and dangerous to play. It’s been like this for over a month, and I haven't seen anyone come to fix it.

I've been trying to use the tennis courts at Madison Square Park, but most of the nets are torn down and the surface is covered in leaves and debris. I just want to enjoy a game without worrying about getting hurt!

Can someone please take a look at the skate park on the Lower East Side? The ramps are splintered and the area is littered with broken glass. It's been like this for weeks and it’s putting skaters at risk.

I went to play some pickleball this weekend at Riverside Park, but the surface was so worn out that my friends and I kept slipping. It's unsafe and disappointing. I’ve been hoping for maintenance to come through for a while now.

label: Consumer Complaint. Supermarket or Grocery Store. Refund, Return, or Exchange Refused
complaints: I bought a carton of milk from the store on Main Street, and when I opened it at home, it was spoiled. When I went back to get a refund, the manager refused to give me one, saying I should've checked it before leaving. Now I'm out of $3 and have to go back to that store again.

I purchased a pair of headphones from that electronics section in my local grocery store, but they didn’t work right out of the box. I tried to return them, but the cashier said they didn't do refunds on electronics. I can’t believe I wasted my money on something so faulty!

Last week, I bought some fresh produce from my neighborhood supermarket, but when I got home, I found mold on several items. When I tried to return them, I was told that it was 'against their policy' to accept returns on perishable goods. This is ridiculous, I shouldn’t have to eat spoiled food!

I went to the store on 5th Avenue to return a shirt that I realized didn’t fit after taking it home. The staff there were rude and told me that they don't do exchanges for clothing. I’ve been a loyal customer for years, but this experience was really disappointing.

label: Sanitation Worker or Vehicle Complaint. Noise. Snow Plow
complaints: I've been up since 4 AM because the snow plow just won't stop driving around my block. It's so loud and it's waking up everyone nearby, including my kids. Can't they do this a little later?

There's a snow plow that has been scraping the pavement outside my apartment for over an hour now. The noise is unbearable and it's making it impossible to concentrate on my work. This isn't the first time it's happened.
I get it, the roads need to be cleared, but the snow plow came by at 3 AM and was making a racket for at least half an hour. I couldn't get back to sleep afterward. This is ridiculous.

Why does the snow plow feel the need to rev its engine at 5 AM? The sound is so disruptive, I can hear it even with my window closed. It would be great if they could schedule this work during the day instead.

label: Food Establishment. Food Protection. Food Display/Storage Improper
complaints: I just walked by the corner deli on 5th and Main, and they had a pile of raw meat sitting out on the counter without proper refrigeration. It was a hot day, and I can't believe that's allowed!
The bakery on my block is leaving boxes of pastries out in the sun for hours. I saw flies landing on them, and it really concerns me about food safety. Can someone check on this?

I visited a restaurant last night, and they had their food products stored at room temperature. I noticed some cheese and cream sitting out for at least an hour while I was there. That's not safe, is it?

I ordered from a food truck downtown today and saw them handling cold items in the heat without any sort of cooling system. The last thing I want is to get sick from something that should have been stored properly.

label: Litter Basket Complaint. Misuse. Used for Commercial Trash
complaints: I live on 7th Avenue and there's a litter basket outside my building that's constantly overflowing with commercial trash. It smells terrible and attracts rats. Could someone please check on this?

Every day I walk past the garbage can on 3rd Street and it's full of actual business waste instead of litter. It's frustrating because it's supposed to be for the public, not restaurants. Can you do something about it?

I’ve noticed that the trash receptacle near the park on 10th Street is being used by nearby shops for their waste. It’s disgusting and makes the area look so unclean. This has been going on for weeks now.
The litter basket on Broadway has been filled with bags of commercial trash for the past few days. It's really making the whole block look bad and has started to attract pests. Please look into this.

label: Water Quality. unknown odor/taste in drinking water (QA6). Qa6
complaints: I've been noticing a strange smell coming from my tap water for the past week, and it has a metallic taste. It’s making it hard to drink, and I'm really worried about what might be in it.

For the last few days, the water from the faucet has been tasting off, almost like chemicals or something. I usually drink a lot of water, but now I’m hesitant to fill my glass unless I let it sit for a while.
This morning, I filled a pot with tap water and immediately noticed a strong, musty odor. I’m concerned because I have young kids at home, and I don't think I should be giving them this water.

The water in my building has been tasting weird for the last several days. It’s almost like it has a chlorine flavor, and I can’t even make coffee with it. This needs to be checked out as soon as possible.

label: Traffic Signal Condition. Street Light Feed. Damaged
complaints: The traffic light at the intersection of 5th Avenue and Main Street has been flickering for the past week. It's really confusing for drivers and pedestrians, and I'm worried someone is going to get hurt.
I noticed that the streetlight on my corner is completely out. It’s been dark there for over a week now, which makes it feel unsafe walking home at night. Can someone please fix it?

The signal at Broadway and 42nd Street is stuck on red, and it’s been that way for at least two days. Cars are getting backed up, and people are starting to run the red light. This needs immediate attention!
There’s a streetlight that has been broken on my block for about ten days. It's pitch black at night, and I don’t feel safe walking home after work. We really need better lighting out here.

label: Bus Stop Shelter Complaint. Snow Removal Requested
complaints: I just got off the bus at the stop near 42nd Street and 8th Avenue, and there's a huge pile of snow blocking the shelter. It's freezing out here, and I can barely wait for my next bus without exposure. Can someone please clear it up?

The bus stop on 3rd Avenue and 1st Street has not been cleared of snow at all. I've been waiting for over half an hour with no shelter from the wind, and it’s just not right. I hope this can be handled soon!

I understand it’s snowy, but it’s been two days and the shelter by my apartment on Broadway is completely covered in snow. It’s really inconvenient for us waiting in the cold. Someone needs to come and take care of this!

Please send someone to clear the snow at the bus stop on 14th Street and 6th Avenue. It looks like nobody has touched it since the storm. I’ve witnessed people struggling to stand and wait for their buses. This shouldn’t be happening in our city.

label: Litter Basket Complaint. Overflowing
complaints: I'm walking past the park on 5th Avenue and the trash bins are overflowing! It’s starting to spill onto the sidewalk and it really smells bad. This has been an issue for the last few days and it’s getting worse.

Could someone please do something about the garbage can at the corner of 23rd and 7th? It’s completely filled to the top and there’s litter all around it. I saw it like this all weekend, and it’s just unacceptable.

The litter basket at the subway entrance on 42nd Street is so full that trash is piling up around it. It's been like this since last week and I can't believe nobody has picked it up yet. It’s not a good look for our city.
I’m really frustrated with the trash situation near my apartment on East 11th Street. The bins are overflowing and it attracts rats. It’s been like that for at least a week now and it’s disgusting.

label: Outdoor Dining. Sidewalk Zone Blocked. Furnishing Zone
complaints: The outdoor dining setup on my block is so crowded that it's nearly impossible for pedestrians to walk by. My elderly neighbor almost tripped over a table yesterday!

I live on a busy street, and the outdoor seating for the restaurant next door takes up almost the entire sidewalk. It’s getting really hard to get my stroller through there, especially with the kids in tow.
Why does the city allow these restaurants to block the sidewalk with their outdoor furniture? I couldn't even walk my dog without stepping into the street to get around all the tables!
I understand restaurants need to make money, but the tables and chairs outside are always spread out everywhere. It's a hassle when I’m just trying to get to the subway during rush hour.

label: Animal in a Park. Domestic Strays. Dog
complaints: I was at Central Park this afternoon and saw a loose dog running around without any owner in sight. It kept barking at people and seemed really agitated. Can someone please help locate its owner or find it a safe place?

There's a friendly-looking dog that's been hanging out in Washington Square Park for a few days now. It doesn't have a collar and looks a little lost. I’m worried about its safety with all the traffic nearby. Can someone check on it?

I walked through Prospect Park yesterday, and there was an unaccompanied pit bull that was roaming around. While it seemed calm, I was really uncomfortable being near it without an owner around. This has been ongoing for over a week now. Please send someone to take a look.

I noticed a small dog running around the playground in Battery Park this morning. It was clearly scared and kept trying to hide. I’m worried it might get hurt, and I can’t believe nobody is looking for it. Can you help?

label: School Maintenance. Rodents/Mice. Signs of Rodents
complaints: I'm really concerned about the number of mice I've been seeing in my child's school. It's alarming to think that they're running around classrooms where kids are eating and learning. This has been happening for weeks now, and I hope something can be done quickly.

My daughter came home the other day talking about a mouse she saw in her classroom. I couldn't believe it! This is the second time this month I've heard about rodents in the school. It's unacceptable and I can't help but worry about the hygiene there.

There have been signs of mice in my son's school; I’ve seen droppings near the cafeteria area. We've been watching this situation for over a month now, and it really needs to be addressed before it gets worse. What are they doing about it?

I just found out that my child’s school has been dealing with a mouse problem for a while. It’s disappointing to hear that the issue has not been resolved. The kids shouldn’t have to worry about sharing their space with rodents, and I feel like this should be taken seriously.

label: Consumer Complaint. E-Cigarette Sales. Flavored Tobacco Products Sold
complaints: I just walked by a corner store on my block and noticed they are selling flavored e-cigarettes, which I thought was banned here. It’s frustrating to see them targeting kids with these products right in our neighborhood.
I’m really concerned about the shop on 5th Avenue that has a huge display of flavored vape products. I don’t want to see our youth getting hooked on these things because they’re marketed like candy.
Can you believe it? The deli near my apartment is openly selling flavored tobacco. I thought those were illegal now! This is not the kind of environment I want for families and kids.

Every time I walk past the bodega on my way to work, I see them promoting those fruity vape flavors. I’m worried about how accessible this is for young people. It feels like nobody is enforcing the rules anymore.

label: Food Establishment. Kitchen/Food Prep Area. Kitchen Equipment Dirty
complaints: I just picked up dinner from that new restaurant on 5th and I have to say, the kitchen area looked pretty grimy when I walked past the open door. I really hope they clean it up before someone gets sick!

I ordered takeout last night from a place on 10th Avenue and noticed a weird smell when I opened the bag. It looked like the kitchen might not have been cleaned properly. I won’t be ordering from there again!

Every time I walk by the deli on my block, I see the staff handling food with dirty hands and the equipment looks like it hasn't been cleaned in days. It’s really concerning, especially during flu season.

I was in a small café on 7th Street last weekend and noticed that the prep counters were covered in crumbs and the equipment looked rusty. This kind of cleanliness just isn't acceptable when you're preparing food for customers.

label: Consumer Complaint. Supermarket or Grocery Store. Expired Medication
complaints: I just bought a bottle of pain relievers from the local supermarket, and when I got home, I noticed it expired last month. I can't believe they would still be selling expired products!
I went to my neighborhood grocery store yesterday and found that several of the cold and flu medications were past their expiration date. I thought stores were supposed to check this regularly?

I purchased a pack of allergy medicine from the pharmacy section of my supermarket last week, only to realize upon opening it that it expired three months ago. This is really unacceptable, especially for something that affects health!
I'm really frustrated because I picked up some vitamins at my local grocery store, and when I opened them, I saw they were expired for over a year. I expect better from stores in this area.

label: Street Sign - Dangling. Speed Limit
complaints: The speed limit sign at the corner of 5th and Main has been hanging by a thread for over a week now. I’m worried that someone might not see it and it could lead to an accident.
I've noticed that the speed limit sign on Baker Street near the school is dangling dangerously low. This has been an issue for the last few days and it needs to be fixed before someone gets hurt.
The speed limit sign on Oak Avenue is barely attached and swaying in the wind. I drive by there every day and I’m concerned that it might fall off soon. Can someone take care of this?
For the past month, the speed limit sign at Elm and 23rd has been hanging awkwardly. It’s hard to see and I really think it should be replaced before a driver misses it completely.

label: Special Projects Inspection Team (SPIT). Advertising Sign/Billboard/Posters/Flexible Fabric - Illegal
complaints: I can't believe how many illegal billboards have popped up on my block in the last few weeks. They’re completely blocking the view of the street signs and making it look cluttered. It’s so distracting when I’m trying to drive through the area!

There’s a huge banner hanging on the side of my building that doesn’t have any permits. It’s been up for over a month and I’m worried it’s going to fall off and hit someone. Can someone please check this out?

I live near the park and there’s this massive, tacky sign advertising a private business that just went up. It’s so out of place and really ruining the vibe of the neighborhood. We can’t have nice things if it’s going to look like a commercial district!

I’ve noticed there’s an increasing amount of illegal posters plastered all over our neighborhood. They’re on every lamppost and sidewalk, and it’s making the area look so messy. I really wish someone would do something about this.

label: Appliance. Refrigerator. Broken Or Missing
complaints: My refrigerator stopped working yesterday and now all my food is spoiling. I need someone to come and take a look at it as soon as possible.
I've been without a functioning fridge for over a week now. I reported the issue already but haven't heard back. This is really affecting my ability to keep groceries and cook any meals.
Last night, my refrigerator started making a strange noise and stopped cooling. I am worried about the food I have inside and need help fixing this quickly.
I'm calling because my fridge is leaking water all over the floor. It's been going on for a few days and I can't seem to fix it myself. I need someone to come out and take care of it.

label: Traffic Signal Condition. Controller. Hanging
complaints: I was driving down Broadway earlier and noticed that the traffic light at 34th Street is hanging at a weird angle. It looks like it might fall off any second, and it’s really throwing off the flow of traffic.
The traffic signal at the intersection of 5th Avenue and 23rd Street is hanging down so low that it's almost at eye level for drivers. It’s not safe and makes it hard to see if it’s red or green.
Can you please do something about the traffic light at 42nd and 8th? It’s been hanging precariously for over a week now, and I’m worried it’s going to cause an accident.

This morning, I saw the traffic signal at 1st Avenue and 59th Street swaying in the wind. It’s barely attached, and I think it’s been like this for a few days now. Drivers are confused and the intersection is getting dangerous.

label: Maintenance or Facility. Snow or Ice. Sidewalk
complaints: I live on 5th Avenue and the sidewalk outside my building is still covered in ice from last week's snow. It’s really dangerous to walk on, and I worry someone will slip and fall, especially with kids around.

I've been struggling to get out of my apartment because the sidewalk is a mess of snow piles and ice. It's been almost a week since the last storm and nothing has been cleared. Can someone please do something about it?

complaints: I'm calling because there is a streetlight missing at the corner of 5th Avenue and 42nd Street. It's incredibly dark at night, and I feel unsafe walking home. I really hope this can be fixed soon!

The intersection of Bleecker and MacDougal is pitch black at night because the streetlight is completely gone. It’s been like this for over a week and I'm worried someone might get hurt. Can we get a replacement?
I just wanted to report that the streetlight at 34th and Broadway has been missing for a while now. It’s hard to cross safely, especially with all the traffic. Please look into getting it replaced.
It's been more than two weeks since the streetlight at 14th and 9th disappeared, and I can barely see anything when I'm trying to walk that way after dark. It’s really unsafe for everyone.

label: Consumer Complaint. Bodega, Deli, or Convenience Store. Price Gouging
complaints: I just went to my local bodega for some snacks and was shocked to see that the prices for basic items like chips and soda have skyrocketed. I paid almost double what I usually do, and it feels like they're just taking advantage of everyone during this tough time.
I can't believe the price of milk at my neighborhood deli. I used to pay $2.50, and now it's almost $4! This is ridiculous, and it's really hitting my budget hard.

Every time I stop by that corner store, the prices seem to go up. I just saw a box of cereal for $10 when it’s usually around $3. It feels like they think they can charge whatever they want because we don’t have other options nearby.

I’ve noticed that my go-to convenience store has been hiking prices without any real reason. I bought a loaf of bread for $5 today when it’s usually $2. It’s frustrating and simply unfair to regular customers.

label: Hazardous Materials. Unsafe Chemical, Storage (HC1). Hc1
complaints: There's a strong, chemical smell coming from a nearby warehouse. I can hardly breathe when I walk past it, especially in the evening. It's been like this for the past few days and it's really concerning.

I live next to an auto-repair shop, and they have been using some sort of chemicals that have a really foul odor. It lingers in the air and makes me worried about what they might be doing. It's been happening for weeks now.

My neighbors have been storing what looks like barrels of some kind of chemical in their backyard. I don't know what it is, but it smells really toxic. I feel uneasy about it, especially with my kids playing outside. It's been going on for a month now.

I've noticed that the old factory down the street has been leaking something that looks like oil or a chemical. There's a puddle forming on the sidewalk, and I'm afraid it's going to seep into the ground or the water supply. This has been happening for a couple of weeks.

label: Smoking or Vaping. Workplace Policy Not Provided or Inadequate
complaints: There's a group of people smoking right outside my office building, and the smell wafts inside. It's unbearable and really distracting when I'm trying to work; can someone do something about it?

I've noticed that my workplace has not enforced any policy regarding smoking in the area. The smoke from outside makes it hard to breathe, especially for those of us with allergies. This needs to be addressed.

Every time I take my break outside, I'm surrounded by clouds of cigarette smoke from employees who are supposed to be on a smoke-free property. It's frustrating, and I don't feel comfortable taking my breaks anymore.

I walked past a construction site where the workers were smoking just a few feet from the entrance to my building. This is not only unpleasant but also unhealthy for everyone passing by. Can we get some help with this?

label: Consumer Complaint. Tow Truck Company. Cars Parked on Sidewalk or Street
complaints: I woke up this morning to find my car missing from its usual parking spot. I checked around and discovered that a tow truck took it away overnight. I’m really frustrated because there were no signs indicating that my car was parked illegally.

There’s a tow truck company operating in my area that seems to be overly aggressive. They’ve towed several of my neighbors’ cars in the last week, often without any warning signs posted. It’s causing a lot of stress for everyone trying to find parking here.

I just watched a tow truck take away a car parked on the street in front of my building, even though it was clearly not blocking anything. This feels like a money grab, especially since we all struggle to find parking in this neighborhood. Can’t something be done about this?

I came home late last night to find my car towed, and I’m furious. I parked in what I thought was a legal spot, but the whole block seems to be filled with confusing signs. I feel like I’m just being targeted for having no clear parking options.

label: Cranes and Derricks. Crane/Suspension Scaffold - No Permit/License/Cert./Unsafe/Illegal
complaints: There's a crane set up right outside my apartment building that looks like it's been there forever. I don't think they have a proper permit, and it's causing a lot of noise and is blocking the sidewalk. It's just so unsafe for everyone walking by!

I'm really concerned about the construction crane near my street. It's been operating without any visible permits for at least two weeks now, and I often see workers up there without proper safety gear. It makes me feel uneasy living so close to it.

There’s a massive crane next to my building that doesn't seem to have any certification or proof of safety. The workers have been up there for days, and I can’t help but worry it’s a disaster waiting to happen. This is in a busy area, and kids walk past every day!

I live on the corner of 5th and Main, and there's a suspended scaffold up with no indication of a permit. It's been hanging there for over a week, and it looks really unsafe. I'm afraid it could come crashing down with all the pedestrians passing underneath.

label: Consumer Complaint. Bodega, Deli, or Convenience Store. Receipt Inaccurate, Incomplete, or Not Given
complaints: I just got home from the bodega, and I noticed they didn't give me a receipt for my groceries. It's frustrating because I want to keep track of my spending, especially with prices going up. Can someone look into this?

I stopped by my local deli this morning, and when I paid for my sandwich, they didn't provide a receipt. I always keep track of what I spend, and it's a hassle when they don’t hand one over. Can someone remind them it's important to issue receipts?

I bought some snacks and drinks from a convenience store yesterday, and they didn’t give me a receipt. Now I can’t return the chips that were stale. It’s really annoying that they didn’t follow standard protocol. Can this be addressed?

I was at a bodega last night and was shocked when I asked for a receipt after my purchase and was told they don’t provide them. I feel like this is just not right. Can something be done about ensuring receipts are provided at all shops?

label: Safety. Fire Escape. Falling Off Wall
complaints: I've noticed that the fire escape on my building is dangerously loose and rattling whenever there's a strong wind. I'm worried it might fall off the wall completely, and there are kids playing nearby. This needs immediate attention!

The fire escape on my apartment building is hanging off the wall and looks ready to fall any day now. I reported this to my landlord weeks ago, but nothing has been done. It's a serious safety hazard, especially for those living on the upper floors!

I just walked past my building and saw that our fire escape has completely detached from the wall on one side. This could lead to a serious accident if someone tries to use it. Can someone please come check this out?

There’s a fire escape that has come loose from the side of my building and dangles precariously over the street. Just yesterday, a delivery person nearly bumped into it. This situation is putting everyone at risk and needs to be fixed ASAP.

label: Taxi Complaint. Driver Complaint - Passenger. License Not Displayed
complaints: I just got out of a taxi in the East Village, and the driver didn't have their license visible at all. It made me really uneasy, especially since I was traveling alone at night. I think it's important for drivers to follow the rules for everyone's safety.

I took a cab from Times Square to my apartment, and the driver had no license displayed. It felt sketchy, and I didn't even get his name. I want to report this because it shouldn't be like this, especially in a busy city like ours.

I was in a yellow cab yesterday, and I noticed the driver's license was completely missing from the front. It just doesn't feel safe to ride with someone who isn't following regulations. Can someone please look into this?

Last weekend, I hailed a cab in Brooklyn and was surprised to see that the driver's license wasn’t anywhere in sight. It gave me a bad feeling about the whole ride. I think there needs to be better enforcement of these rules.

label: Traffic Signal Condition. Warning Signal. Out
complaints: I live near the intersection of 5th and Main, and the warning signal has been out for over a week now. It’s really dangerous for pedestrians and drivers alike, especially during rush hour. Can someone please fix it?

I wanted to report that the warning signal at the corner of 42nd and Broadway isn't working. I've seen several close calls between cars and pedestrians in the last couple of days, and it’s becoming a serious hazard. This needs immediate attention!

The warning signal at 14th Street and 8th Avenue has been malfunctioning since last Sunday. Cars are just zooming through without stopping, which is making it really scary to cross. I hope this can be addressed soon before someone gets hurt.

I've noticed that the warning signal at the intersection of 23rd and Park is completely out. It’s been like this for at least three days now, and I’m concerned about the safety of everyone trying to get through that busy area. Please send someone to check it out.

label: Unsanitary Animal Pvt Property. Cat. Odor
complaints: I've been dealing with a terrible smell coming from my neighbor's yard for weeks now. It smells like cat urine and it's unbearable. I can't keep my windows open because of it, and I'm worried about the impact on my family's health.

There’s a persistent odor from a cat living next door. It’s been so bad lately that I can’t even enjoy my patio. I’ve tried talking to my neighbor, but nothing changes. It’s really affecting my quality of life.

I live on the fifth floor, and there's this awful smell wafting up from the first floor’s balcony where they keep their cats. It’s been going on for over a month now, and I don’t know what to do anymore. I’ve tried air fresheners, but it’s just too strong.

Every time I step outside, I’m hit with this foul odor that seems to be coming from the apartment next to mine. I think it’s from their cats because it smells like litter box. It’s so strong that it seeps into my apartment. I’d appreciate some help resolving this issue.

label: Air Quality. Air: Smoke, Vehicular (AA4). Aa4
complaints: I'm really struggling with the amount of smoke from the traffic on my street. It feels like there's a thick haze every morning, and I can't even open my windows without feeling sick. This has been going on for weeks now.

The air quality in my neighborhood has been terrible lately. There’s constant vehicle smoke that makes it hard to breathe, especially during rush hour. I have allergies, and this is really affecting my health. Can something be done?

I've noticed a strong smell of exhaust in my apartment that’s making my eyes water. It seems to be worse during the evenings when traffic picks up. I love living here, but the air pollution is really bothering me.

Every time I step outside, I smell the fumes from all the cars and trucks driving by. It’s especially bad on weekends when there’s more traffic. I’m worried about how this will impact my kids' health in the long run.

label: Street Sign - Damaged. Yield
complaints: I just drove through the intersection of 5th and Main, and the yield sign is completely bent over. I really worry that someone is going to miss it and cause an accident.
The yield sign on Oak Street at the corner of Maple has been smashed for weeks now. It’s really dangerous, especially with kids walking to school nearby.
There’s a yield sign near my apartment that’s been hanging by a thread for at least a month. Cars keep flying through the intersection because they can’t see it properly.
Could someone please fix the yield sign on 2nd Avenue? It’s almost lying flat on the ground, and I’ve seen several near misses as cars don’t seem to notice it anymore.

label: Food Establishment. Food Worker Hygiene. Hair Restraint Not Worn
complaints: I just picked up lunch from a local deli and noticed the worker didn’t have a hairnet on. I really didn’t feel comfortable eating my sandwich after that.
I was at the café on 3rd Street this morning, and one of the employees had long hair hanging down without any restraint. It seriously made me rethink my order.
I visited the bakery on 5th Avenue yesterday, and the staff behind the counter were all handling food with their hair down. I found it quite unappetizing and didn’t finish my pastry.
While I was waiting for my coffee at the shop on 7th Avenue, I saw a barista with loose hair touching the pastries. I can’t believe they don't follow basic hygiene standards.

label: Street Sign - Damaged. Detour
complaints: I just drove down 5th Avenue and saw that the stop sign at the corner of 12th Street is completely bent over. It’s hard to see, and I’m worried it’ll cause an accident if it’s not fixed soon.

There’s a detour sign that’s been hanging off its post at the intersection of Broadway and 42nd for days now. It’s swaying in the wind and looks like it could fall at any moment. Can someone please take care of that?

The street sign at the corner of 34th and 8th is damaged and barely legible. I couldn’t tell if it was telling me to go straight or turn, and it really confused a few drivers around me. It needs to be replaced ASAP.

I encountered a detour sign that’s totally obscured by overgrown trees on Elm Street. I drove past it without realizing I needed to change routes and ended up stuck in traffic for 30 minutes. Can someone trim those trees and move the sign?

label: General Construction/Plumbing. Excavation Undermining Adjacent Building
complaints: There's constant banging and drilling going on outside my apartment on 5th Avenue that hasn't stopped for days. It's driving me crazy and making it hard to focus on my work from home.
I live near a construction site and I'm really worried that all the heavy machinery is undermining the building next to mine. I can see cracks appearing, and it’s been going on for weeks now.

I noticed there’s a huge hole in the street outside my building, and I’m not sure if it’s safe for pedestrians. It’s been like that for almost a month, and I’m concerned it’s damaging the adjacent structures.
There’s been construction outside my place on 34th Street that’s shaking the building pretty badly. It’s been going on for too long, and I feel like the integrity of our building is at risk.

label: Food Establishment. Food Preparation Location. Made at Home/Unpermited Site
complaints: I just moved into the neighborhood and there's a strong smell of food cooking coming from the apartment next door. It’s so overpowering that it seeps into my place, especially in the evenings. I can’t even enjoy my own meals anymore!

I’ve been noticing that a home kitchen nearby has people coming and going at all hours, often late into the night. The smell of frying food has become unbearable, and I’m worried about the health and safety standards. This needs to be looked into.

There’s a house down the block that seems to have someone cooking large quantities of food regularly. The grease smell is awful, and it really bothers my allergies. This has been going on for weeks and I’m not sure how to handle it without causing a scene.

I keep hearing loud noises and laughter from the place across the street almost every weekend. They seem to be running some kind of illegal food operation. The last thing I want is a party atmosphere every Friday night, especially when I have to get up early for work.

label: Consumer Complaint. Furniture Store. Goods or Services Not Delivered
complaints: I ordered a couch from a furniture store over a month ago, and they promised delivery within two weeks. It's been longer than that, and every time I call, I get different reasons for the delay. I'm tired of waiting and just want my couch!

I paid in full for a dining table to be delivered last week, but it never showed up. I’ve tried reaching out to the store multiple times, but no one is returning my calls. This is incredibly frustrating!

Last month, I purchased a bedroom set and was told it would arrive in five days. Now it's been three weeks, and I'm still sleeping on the floor. This is unacceptable, and I feel like I've been completely ignored!

I ordered a sofa last month and was given a specific delivery date, but the day came and went without any update from the store. I’ve emailed them and still haven’t received a response. I really need this resolved soon!

label: Traffic Signal Condition. Veh Signal Lamp. Turned
complaints: I've noticed that the traffic signal at the corner of 34th and 8th has been out for over a week. It makes crossing the street really dangerous, especially with so many pedestrians and cars in that area.

The traffic light at Broadway and 42nd is stuck on red, and it's been like this for the last couple of days. Cars just keep running through without any regard for safety! It's really unnerving when I'm trying to cross.
Can you please look into the traffic signal at 23rd Street and 5th Avenue? It keeps blinking yellow instead of changing to red at intersections, and I’ve seen multiple near misses because of it.
The pedestrian signal at 57th and 9th is malfunctioning and has been for the past few days. It doesn't illuminate at all, which is making it tough for people to cross safely during busy times.

label: Hazardous Materials. Oil Spill On Street, Small (HQS). Hqs
complaints: I just noticed a small oil spill on my street near the intersection. It’s been there for a couple of days, and it's making the area look really dirty. I'm worried it might cause someone to slip and fall, especially the kids who play nearby.
There’s an oil slick on the road by my building, and it’s getting worse. I saw a few cars almost lose control trying to navigate around it. Can someone come clean it up before someone gets hurt?

I live on 7th Avenue, and there’s a small oil spill that’s been sitting there for over a week now. It’s right where people stop to wait for the bus, and the smell is unbearable. This needs to be taken care of ASAP!

There’s a patch of oil on the street outside my apartment that’s not just an eyesore, but it also poses a hazard to cyclists. I’ve seen a few close calls where people almost slipped. I hope someone can address this issue soon.

label: General. Signage Missing. Janitor/Super Emergency Contact
complaints: The street sign at the corner of 5th Avenue and 34th Street has been missing for weeks, and I'm worried that it's causing confusion for drivers. Can someone please look into replacing it?

I've been trying to get in touch with the superintendent of my building because the stairwell lights are out, but I can’t find the emergency contact number posted anywhere. Can someone please make sure these signs are up?

There's been no 'No Parking' sign on my block for about a month now, and cars are parked everywhere, making it impossible for emergency vehicles to get through. It's getting dangerously overcrowded here!

I've noticed that the sign directing people to the nearby park has been knocked down. A lot of new families have moved in, and it’s hard for them to find the entrance without clear signage. Please address this soon.

label: Pet Sale. Animals Sold From Residence
complaints: I've noticed that a couple of houses on my street have been selling puppies right from their front yards. It seems really sketchy and they often have large crowds gathering and making noise. This has been going on for weeks now, and it's causing a lot of disruption.

There’s a house around the corner that has people coming in and out all day buying kittens. I can’t tell if they’re running a legitimate business, but it feels really uncomfortable. It's not what I expect to see in my neighborhood, plus it smells bad sometimes.

I’m concerned about a home nearby where I’ve seen signs advertising pet sales. I don’t think they have proper licenses because there are always a bunch of different breeds, and I worry about the conditions these animals are kept in. It’s been happening for over a month now.

I’ve been hearing barking and yowling coming from a house a few blocks away. They seem to be selling dogs and cats from their living room. The noise is unbearable, and it seems very unregulated. Please check this out before someone gets hurt or those animals are put in a bad situation.

label: Lost Property. Book/Stationery. Book
complaints: I lost my favorite book on the subway yesterday during my commute. It was a signed copy and really important to me. If anyone found it, I would appreciate any help in getting it back.
Can you please help me? I accidentally left a hardcover novel on a bench in Central Park around noon today. It's a unique edition with a blue cover, and I just can't believe I lost it!
I think I left my book at a coffee shop in the East Village last weekend. It's an old paperback and means a lot to me. If anyone has seen it, could you please let me know?

I misplaced a journal in a taxi about three days ago. It has quite a few personal notes in it, and I'm worried someone might find it and use it irresponsibly. Any advice on what I can do to try and locate it would be appreciated!

label: Broken Parking Meter. No Receipt
complaints: I just parked my car on 5th Avenue, and the meter is completely broken. I put my money in, but it didn't give me a receipt, and now I'm worried about getting a ticket. Can someone please check on it?

I’m really frustrated because the parking meter at the corner of 42nd and 8th is not working. I tried multiple times to pay, but it won’t accept my card or cash. I can’t afford a ticket for something that’s not my fault!

The parking meter in front of my apartment on 10th Street has been out of order all week. I've tried to pay several times, but it just keeps flashing an error message. I don’t want to risk getting fined for a broken machine. Can someone look into it?

I parked near Central Park yesterday, and the parking meter wouldn’t give me a receipt despite accepting my payment. I’m worried that I’m going to get a ticket because it looks like I didn’t pay. This has been a huge inconvenience.

label: Sewer Maintenance. Catch Basin Sunken
complaints: I've noticed a catch basin on my street has been sunken for weeks now. It's really starting to create a hazard for pedestrians, especially with all the rain we've been having. Can someone please come fix it?
The catch basin near my building is so sunken that it collects water every time it rains. It's been like this for over a month, and it's causing a mess. Please send someone out to take care of it.

I walk my dog past that sunken catch basin on 5th Avenue every day, and it's becoming a serious trip hazard. I’m worried someone will get hurt. This has been an issue for at least two weeks now. Can it be fixed soon?

There’s a catch basin on Maple Street that’s completely out of level. It’s been like this for a while, and with winter approaching, I’m concerned it’s going to freeze and cause even bigger issues. It needs attention right away.

label: Lot Condition. Trash
complaints: I live on 5th Avenue and I've noticed a mountain of garbage piling up in the lot across the street. It's been there for over a week and it’s starting to attract rats. We really need someone to come and clean it up before it gets worse.

The vacant lot next to my apartment on East 39th Street has become a dumping ground. There’s trash everywhere, and it’s not just annoying—it’s starting to smell awful. Can someone please take care of this?

I walk my dog past the empty lot on West 10th Street every morning, and it’s just filled with litter and discarded furniture. It's been like this for weeks, and it’s really ruining the area. We need some action on this, please!
I live near the corner of Jackson and 14th, and the lot there is covered in trash. It looks terrible and is attracting more garbage. Could you please send someone to clean it up?

label: Rodent. Signs of Rodents. Holes or Burrows
complaints: I've noticed some burrows showing up in my backyard over the past week, and I'm really concerned about rodents coming in. It's frustrating because I can't let my kids play outside with those holes so close by.

There are holes in the garden near my apartment building, and I've seen rats scurrying around in the evenings. It's been happening for a couple of weeks now, and it's really unsettling. Can you please do something about this?

I've found several small holes along the edge of my yard, and I'm worried that rodents might be nesting there. This has been going on for about a month, and I'm anxious about my pets getting into trouble.

For the last few days, I've seen what looks like burrow entrances near the garbage cans behind my building. It's a real problem, and I'm not sure what can be done to stop these rodents from getting closer to our homes.

label: Overgrown Tree/Branches. Clear Street Light
complaints: I've been trying to walk my dog at night, but the overgrown branches from the tree in front of my building are blocking the street light. It's way too dark and feels unsafe. Can someone please take care of this?
The tree next to my apartment has branches hanging low and it's gotten really bad lately. They block the street light right outside my window, making it hard to see anything when I go out at night.

There’s a huge tree on my block that's completely overgrown. The branches are so low they hit my car when I park. Plus, they block almost all the light from the street lamp, making it really scary to walk home after dark.

I've noticed that the light on my street is barely working because of the tree branches hanging over it. It's affecting my ability to get to my home safely, especially since I come back late from work. Can someone please trim those branches?

label: Consumer Complaint. Bodega, Deli, or Convenience Store. Refund or Return Policy Not Posted
complaints: I just walked into the bodega on 5th Avenue, and I noticed they don’t have any signs about their return policy. I tried to return an item that was spoiled, and they wouldn’t take it back. It’s frustrating that I didn’t know I was taking a risk buying that!

I bought some expired snacks at the deli on 23rd and was shocked to find that they have no visible return policy posted. When I asked the cashier about it, he just shrugged. I think it’s unfair for customers to be left in the dark like this.

Can someone please look into the convenience store on 42nd Street? They don’t have any information about how to return items, and I ended up stuck with a defective product. It feels really shady to me. I shouldn’t have to guess their policy!

I went to the corner store on 10th Avenue to return a drink that was already opened and flat. They didn’t accept it and didn’t have anything posted about returns, which I think is ridiculous. How am I supposed to know what to expect when they don’t communicate anything?

label: Mobile Food Vendor. Equipment. Incorrect/Missing Equipment
complaints: I live near the corner of 7th and 45th, and every day there's a food cart that smells amazing, but it seems like they never have the right supplies. Yesterday, they ran out of buns right at lunchtime, and the line was super long. It was pretty frustrating.

There's this taco truck on my block that has been operating for a while, but they keep running out of the popular items like guacamole and tortillas. It happened again today around noon, and people were visibly disappointed and left. They really need to get their inventory sorted out!

On my way to work this morning, I noticed the hot dog vendor didn't have any mustard or ketchup. It was so disappointing because I had craved a classic New York hot dog. This is the third time this month I've encountered the same issue. Why can't they keep their supplies stocked?

There's a popular food vendor near my apartment, but they always seem to be missing key ingredients. Just last week, they ran out of the essentials during lunch hours when the crowd was huge. It feels like they need to manage their supplies better to keep customers happy.

label: Consumer Complaint. Scale Dealer or Repairer. Unlicensed
complaints: I took my car to a shop on Main Street thinking I was getting a good deal, but they end up charging me for repairs they never made. I have a feeling they didn't even have a legitimate license to operate, and now I'm stuck with a bill and no work done on my vehicle.

I recently got my brakes checked at a local garage, and I think they did a shoddy job. The brake pads started making a loud noise again just two days later, and I found out they aren't a licensed dealer. Now I'm worried about my safety on the road.

Last week, I went to a mechanic who claimed to be certified, but I discovered he isn't. He replaced my battery and charged me way too much for a used one. I feel completely scammed and unsure of where to turn for help now.

I'm really frustrated with this auto shop I went to on Broadway. They seemed sketchy from the start, and now I’m dealing with a car that won’t start only a week after they said they fixed it. I later found out they have no license to operate.

label: Maintenance or Facility. Structure - Outdoors. Gate
complaints: The gate at the entrance of the park on 5th Avenue has been broken for over a week now. It’s really frustrating because I’ve seen kids trying to climb over it just to get in, and it’s not safe.

I’ve been trying to access the basketball courts at the local park, but the gate has been stuck for days. I hoped it would be fixed before the weekend, but it's still not working, and it’s impacting our games.

Can someone please look into the rusty gate at the playground on 10th Street? It squeaks loudly every time it opens, and I worry that it might fall off one of these days. My kids love playing there, but I don't want them around a potentially hazardous structure.

The gate to the community garden has been locked for the past two weeks, and no one seems to know why. It’s disappointing because I was looking forward to helping out with the plants this season. I just hope it opens back up soon.

label: School Maintenance. Plumbing Problem. Other Water Source
complaints: I've been noticing a persistent leak in the bathroom of my child's school for weeks now. It creates a slippery hazard for the kids and nobody seems to be doing anything about it. Can someone please address this before someone gets hurt?

The water fountains at my daughter's school have been out of service for over two months. It's really frustrating because the kids are always complaining about being thirsty, and I can’t send them with water bottles every day! Please fix this soon.

There's a serious plumbing issue in my son's school. There’s a constant foul smell in the hallways, and the bathrooms are often out of order. It's been like this for far too long, and it really needs immediate attention.

I was at my child's school for the parent-teacher conference yesterday, and I noticed that toilets were overflowing all afternoon. It was gross and really awkward for everyone. This has to be fixed to ensure a healthy environment for the kids and staff.

label: E-Scooter. Improperly Parked or Abandoned. Veo
complaints: I just walked out of my apartment on 15th Street, and there’s an e-scooter just lying on the sidewalk. It’s blocking the whole path, making it really hard for people with strollers and wheelchairs to get by. This is becoming a daily issue in the neighborhood!
There’s an abandoned scooter on my block that's been there for several days now. It's not only an eyesore but also a hazard for pedestrians. Can someone come and remove it?

I'm so frustrated—there’s a Veo scooter parked right in front of my building on the corner of 2nd Avenue and 12th Street. I almost tripped over it this morning! It needs to be moved so people can walk safely. It’s been there for hours now!

Every time I walk to the subway, I see e-scooters just dumped everywhere. Today, one is propped against a tree, and another is blocking an entrance. Can we please get some guidelines for how these things should be parked? It’s getting ridiculous.

label: Broken Parking Meter. Missing/Stump
complaints: I came back to my car near 34th Street this afternoon and noticed the parking meter was completely missing. It’s incredibly frustrating because I have no idea if I owe money or not, and I don’t want to risk a ticket.
Last night, I parked on 5th Avenue and found a broken parking meter. I tried to use it, but the machine was unresponsive. Now I'm worried about getting a ticket since I couldn't pay for my spot.
There’s a stump where the parking meter used to be on my block. It’s been gone for weeks, and I feel nervous leaving my car there without paying. Can someone please replace it?

I parked on West 20th Street yesterday, and the meter had been taken away, leaving just a hole in the ground. I didn’t realize it until after I parked, and I’m anxious about getting ticketed for not paying.

label: Consumer Complaint. Dry Cleaner. Clothing Damaged
complaints: I took my favorite coat to the dry cleaner last week, and when I got it back, there were visible stains on it that weren't there before. I’m really upset because I can’t wear it like this!

label: Water Conservation. Rooftank Leak Or Overflow (CKO). Cko
complaints: I've noticed a constant dripping sound coming from my rooftop tanks for the last week. It seems like they might be leaking, and with the amount of water that's been spilling over, I'm worried about water waste and damage to my building.

complaints: The streetlight at the corner of 5th Avenue and 12th Street keeps flickering on and off all night. It's been like this for over a week, and it really makes the intersection feel unsafe when it’s so dark.

complaints: I was walking through the street fair on 5th Avenue yesterday and noticed a vendor selling food without any permits. It made me uneasy not knowing if the food was safe to eat. They were set up right next to a licensed vendor, which just doesn’t seem fair.

This weekend’s street fair had multiple vendors that appeared to be operating without any kind of licenses. I’m worried about food safety and the lack of regulation. It feels like these unlicensed vendors are taking business away from those who follow the rules.

I attended the street fair on Saturday and saw a vendor selling clothing who had no visible permits. I’m concerned because it makes me question the quality of the products. I believe vendors should be required to have proper licenses, especially in an event like this.

I was really enjoying the street fair until I realized many of the food stands didn’t have proper permits. I ended up not buying anything because I didn’t want to risk eating something unsafe. Can these vendors be checked for permits?

label: Consumer Complaint. Garage or Parking Lot. Car Not Available
complaints: I parked my car in the garage on Main Street two days ago and now it's missing. The attendant claims they have no idea where it could be. This is incredibly frustrating and I'm worried it might have been stolen.

I've been going back and forth with the parking lot on 10th Avenue for over a week. They keep telling me my car is available, but every time I show up, it’s not there. I’m tired of this runaround.

label: Consumer Complaint. Tow Truck Company. Vehicle Damage
complaints: I parked my car in a legal spot, and when I returned, it had been towed without notice. Now I see there are scratches all over the side. I’m really frustrated because my car was in perfect condition before this.

complaints: I’ve got a terrible sewer smell coming from my bathroom. It started a couple of days ago and has only gotten worse, making it really hard to be in there. Can someone come take a look at the plumbing?

label: Animal-Abuse. Neglected. Bird
complaints: There's a bird that seems to be stuck outside my apartment for days now. It looks really weak and hasn't moved much. I can hear it chirping, but I'm worried it's not getting any food or water.

complaints: I live near First Avenue and I can barely get to my building anymore because of the outdoor dining setup. The tables and chairs spill over onto the sidewalk and it's making it impossible for people to pass by safely.

There's a restaurant on my block that has completely taken over the sidewalk with their dining area. I'm in a wheelchair, and I often have to go into the street to get around it, which is really dangerous.

complaints: The sidewalk outside my building is so uneven because of that old newspaper box. It's been there for months, and I'm worried someone might trip and fall. Can someone please take a look?

The newspaper stand on my block has fallen apart, and the pieces are jutting out into the walkway. I have to walk around it every time I leave the house, and it's becoming a real inconvenience. It needs to be fixed or removed ASAP.

label: Taxi Complaint. Vehicle Complaint. Broken Card Reader or Screen
complaints: I just got out of a cab and the card reader was broken. The driver didn’t have any cash, and I had to get out and find an ATM late at night. This was really frustrating!

label: Consumer Complaint. Home Heating Oil Company. Overcharge
