label: Sanitation Worker or Vehicle Complaint. Unsafe Driving. Snow Plow
complaints: I was walking my dog on 5th Avenue this morning when a snow plow came barreling down the street at a speed that felt completely reckless. I could barely move out of the way in time, and I'm worried someone else might not be so lucky next time.

Can someone please look into the driving of the snow plow on 86th Street last night? It was weaving in and out of traffic and almost hit three parked cars. This kind of driving is unacceptable, especially in weather like we had!

I'm frustrated with how the snow plow was driving down my block on East 79th Street last night. It wasn't just fast, but it was also swerving all over the place. I have young kids, and I shouldn’t have to fear for their safety on our own street.

Just witnessed a snow plow speeding through a red light at the intersection of Broadway and 42nd. It almost hit a pedestrian and just continued on without slowing down. This can't keep happening; it's dangerous!

label: Consumer Complaint. Department Store or Megastore. Refund, Return, or Exchange Refused
complaints: I bought a shirt last week and when I got home, I realized it had a huge stain on it. I went back to the store to return it, but they refused to take it back because I didn't have the receipt. I can't believe they wouldn't help me out with such a clear issue!

I tried to return a blender I purchased about two months ago because it doesn’t work as promised. The staff at the store was extremely rude and wouldn’t process my return even though it’s still under warranty. I’m really frustrated and feel like I wasted my money.

Last month, I bought a pair of shoes that started falling apart after just two weeks. When I went to exchange them, the manager told me that they don’t do exchanges on sale items, which is not what I was told when I bought them. I feel cheated!

I ordered a coffee maker online and when it arrived, it was missing a crucial part. I called customer service to get a replacement, but they flat out refused to send me one without me returning the entire item, which is ridiculous. I just want to fix what’s wrong!

label: Maintenance or Facility. Structure - Outdoors. Stairway
complaints: The stairs in front of my building have become dangerously cracked and uneven. I've seen several neighbors trip over them, including an elderly woman last week who fell hard. Can we please get someone to come out and fix them?

Every time it rains, the stairs leading to the subway entrance become slippery and treacherous. I've nearly slipped multiple times and I worry for people with mobility issues. This has been an ongoing problem for weeks now.

I live on the corner of 5th and Broadway, and the outdoor stairway has not been properly cleaned for ages. There's grime and litter everywhere, making it unpleasant and unsafe for anyone trying to use them, especially at night.

The stairwell outside my building is covered in graffiti and looks terrible. It's been like this for over a month now, and it's really bringing down the vibe of our neighborhood. Can someone please send someone to clean it up?

label: General Construction/Plumbing. Failure to Comply with Vacate Order
complaints: There's a building on my block that was supposed to be vacated weeks ago, but I see people going in and out like nothing happened. It's really concerning and unsafe for everyone around. Can someone do something about this?

I live near a construction site that was ordered to stop work due to safety violations last month. Despite the order, it seems like they’re still doing whatever they want. I don’t feel safe walking by there anymore.

I don't understand why the construction crew hasn't left the site after being told to vacate. It's been over a month, and I hear noises at all hours. It feels like a serious violation, and I’m worried about the impact on the neighborhood.

It’s frustrating to see a vacate order ignored. The construction workers are still there every day, and the noise is unbearable. This has been going on for too long and is affecting our quality of life.

label: Consumer Complaint. Garage or Parking Lot. Rates Not Posted
complaints: I parked at the garage on 53rd and 7th yesterday and there were no rates posted anywhere. When I went to pay, I was shocked at how much they charged me. It's frustrating not to know what I'm getting into before I park.

I just left a parking lot in the East Village that didn’t display any rates. I had to guess how much I would be charged, and it turned out to be way more than I expected. This is ridiculous, and it should be required to have clear signage!

I parked my car in a garage near Times Square last night, and there were no posted rates. I ended up paying an outrageous price just for a few hours. There should be transparency about charges before you hand over your keys.

I used a parking garage on 14th Street earlier today and was astounded to find no rate information anywhere. Upon checkout, the price was excessive. It’s unfair to charge people without giving them a chance to compare or decide!

label: Animal-Abuse. Chained
complaints: I just walked by a house on my block and saw a dog chained up outside without any shelter. It’s freezing out and it’s been like this for hours. I’m really worried about the poor thing.
There’s a dog in my neighbor's yard that’s been tied to a post all day with no food or water. It’s been barking non-stop for the past two hours. Can someone please check on it?
I noticed a dog that’s been chained up in front of a building for days now. It looks thin and is clearly distressed. This isn’t right and I feel like someone needs to intervene for its well-being.

Every time I pass by the park, there’s this large dog tied up to a tree with no one around. The leash is too short for it to move comfortably, and it looks really unhappy. I think someone should take a look at this situation.

label: Consumer Complaint. Other Store (Non-Food). Refund, Return, or Exchange Refused
complaints: I bought a jacket from a store in Brooklyn last month, and I tried to return it today because it doesn’t fit. They refused to give me a refund and said their policy was final sale, but that wasn’t clear when I made the purchase. I feel cheated!

I recently attempted to exchange a pair of shoes at a Manhattan store, but they wouldn’t let me because I didn’t have the original packaging. I didn’t know it was a requirement, and now I’m stuck with shoes I can’t wear. This is so frustrating!

I went to return a faulty blender to a shop in the East Village, and they insisted I can only get store credit, even though the item was defective. I shouldn’t have to accept a store credit for something that was broken when I bought it. It’s unacceptable!

I bought a dress online from a store that had a return policy advertised, but when I tried to return it in person, they said that online purchases couldn’t be returned in-store. No one told me that when I ordered it, and now I’m out of luck.

label: Highway Sign - Damaged. Exit/Route
complaints: The exit sign for the FDR Drive at 42nd Street is completely bent over, making it hard to see when driving. It has been like this for at least a week, and I worry someone will miss the exit and cause an accident.

I just drove past the sign indicating the exit for the George Washington Bridge, and it's been damaged for so long that it's practically unreadable. I think it's been like this for over a month, and it’s really confusing for drivers trying to navigate during rush hour.

Can someone please fix the exit sign for the Brooklyn Bridge on the BQE? It's obscured by a tree branch and has been that way for days. I’ve seen multiple cars miss the exit because they can’t see it in time.

The route sign for the West Side Highway near 14th Street is damaged and leaning at an awkward angle. It's been like this for a couple of weeks now, and it’s causing confusion for drivers who need to know which lane to be in.

label: Traffic Signal Condition. LED Pedestrian Unit. Obscured (Dirty)
complaints: I’ve been trying to cross on 5th Avenue and 23rd Street, but the pedestrian signal is so dirty I can barely see if it’s on. It’s been like this for a week, and it’s frustrating because it feels unsafe to cross.

The pedestrian light at the intersection of Broadway and 42nd Street is completely obscured by grime. I’m worried that I might miss it when it changes, especially with all the foot traffic around here.

Can someone please clean the LED pedestrian signal at the corner of 14th and 6th? It’s so filthy that I can't tell if it's green or red. I’ve noticed this for days now, and it’s confusing when I’m trying to cross with my kids.

There's a pedestrian light at the junction of 1st Avenue and 34th Street that hasn't been cleaned in ages. I’m really anxious every time I try to cross there because I can't see the signal properly. It's been at least two weeks since I first noticed this issue.

label: School Maintenance. Graffiti
complaints: I walked by the elementary school on 5th Avenue and noticed some really ugly graffiti on the side of the building. It’s been there for weeks, and it’s such an eyesore for the neighborhood.

Can someone please clean up the graffiti off the middle school on 10th Street? It’s all over the front entrance, and it’s making the place look neglected, especially with parents dropping off their kids.

The high school on Maple Avenue has been tagged with graffiti for months now, and it’s really affecting the community's image. I’m worried about what this says to the students and families in our area.
I just passed by the local school on Oak Street, and the graffiti is getting worse. It’s really disappointing to see our kids’ school in such a terrible state. Can someone take care of this?

label: Traffic Signal Condition. Vehicle Signal. Hanging
complaints: There's a traffic light at the corner of 5th and Main that's been hanging at a weird angle for over a week. It's hard to tell when it changes, and I worry it's going to cause an accident soon.
I've noticed that the traffic signal at 34th and Broadway is dangling precariously. It's been like that for several days, and with all the cars and pedestrians, it feels really unsafe.

The stoplight at 42nd Street and 8th Avenue is hanging down so low that I can barely see it from my car. This has been an issue for about a week now, and I think it needs urgent attention before someone gets hurt.

Every morning, the traffic light at 23rd and 6th is hanging down so much that it causes confusion among drivers. I’ve seen a few near misses in just the last couple of days. It definitely needs to be fixed soon!

label: Taxi Complaint. Vehicle Complaint. Broken/Missing Equipment
complaints: I took a taxi from Central Park to my apartment in the East Village, and the driver was incredibly rude. He kept complaining about the traffic and even yelled at me when I asked him to take another route. This is unacceptable behavior for a cab driver.

The taxi I got into this morning had a broken meter. I didn’t realize until the end of the ride when he told me the fare was double what it should’ve been. It felt like I was being scammed and I didn’t know how to handle it.

I was in a cab yesterday, and the seatbelt was completely frayed and barely functional. It’s scary to think about how unsafe that could be. Can’t believe taxis are allowed to operate with such poor equipment.

Last night I waited for a taxi for over 30 minutes during rush hour, and when one finally came, it was filthy inside. There was trash on the floor and the seats had stains all over. It’s disappointing to see such a lack of care for passengers.

label: Broken Parking Meter. Timer Defect - Fast/Fail
complaints: I just parked my car on 5th Avenue and the meter expired after only 20 minutes, even though I paid for an hour. I feel like I'm just throwing money away! Can someone please check it?
The parking meter on 42nd Street is malfunctioning. I put money in, and it just keeps blinking without accepting it. I don’t want to risk a ticket because of this broken meter!
I parked my car by Central Park and the meter jumped to 'expired' way too quickly. I swear I barely had time to grab my coffee before I got a parking ticket! This is really frustrating.
I was running errands in the East Village and the meter was broken. It wouldn't accept coins or my card. I ended up having to move my car and lost valuable time. Can someone fix it?

label: Industrial Waste. Oil Spill Into Basin/Sewer - Large (IABL). Iabl
complaints: There’s a strong smell of oil near the East River where I usually walk my dog. It's been like this for a couple of days now, and I can see a sheen on the water. It really freaks me out, especially with all the wildlife around.
I noticed an oily substance in the storm drain on 5th Avenue and it’s been there since last week. The smell is awful and I’m worried it might contaminate the area. What’s being done about it?

This morning, I saw what looked like an oil spill seeping into the water by the docks on the Lower East Side. I’ve lived here for years, and I’ve never seen anything like this. It’s not just unsightly; it’s hazardous for the environment and the people nearby.

I’ve been smelling something really bad around the park near the waterfront. After looking closer, I noticed the water is discolored and oily. It’s been like this for a week, and it’s starting to drive me and my neighbors insane. Can someone do something about this?

label: Maintenance or Facility. Snow or Ice. Bike Path/Greenways
complaints: The bike lane on 5th Avenue is completely covered in ice. I tried to ride my bike this morning, and it was too dangerous. Can someone please clear it?
I was out on my bike yesterday and nearly slipped on the icy path by Central Park West. It’s been days since the snow cleared up, and that spot is still a hazard for cyclists!

I’ve noticed that the bike lanes in my neighborhood haven’t been treated properly since the snowstorm earlier this week. I saw a few cyclists almost fall because of the ice. This should be addressed immediately!
The bike path along the East River is still a mess from the recent snowfall. I had to ride in the traffic lane because the bike path is unsafe. It’s been over a week now, and nothing has changed.

label: Broken Parking Meter. Bent/Loose
complaints: I parked my car on 5th Avenue yesterday, and the meter was completely bent, making it impossible to put in my change. I ended up having to find another spot and it was just a huge hassle.
The parking meter on 10th Street is loose and keeps wobbling whenever I try to use it. I can't even tell if it's working properly, which is really frustrating when you're in a rush.

Just wanted to let you know that the parking meter by the subway entrance on Broadway is broken. It looks like it had some damage and the display is all messed up, making it really difficult to pay for parking.
I tried to use the parking meter on Union Square last night, but it's all bent and doesn’t take coins. I ended up getting a ticket because I couldn't pay, and it's really unfair.

label: Bus Stop Shelter Complaint. Lighting
complaints: The bus stop at 34th and 8th Avenue has no lighting at night, and it feels really unsafe waiting there after dark. Can someone please get the lights fixed?
I waited for my bus at the stop near Central Park last night, and it was pitch black. There's no way for anyone to see who's around, and it's really concerning. It's been like this for weeks!

The shelter at the bus stop on Broadway and 72nd Street has broken lights, which makes it uncomfortable for all the people waiting there after sunset. I reported it last week, but nothing has changed!

Last night I was at the bus stop on 42nd and 6th, and I couldn’t see anything because the lights are out. It’s hard enough to get around at night, and now I have to deal with dimly lit bus stops too. Please get this resolved.

label: Consumer Complaint. Newsstand. Unlicensed
complaints: There's a newsstand on the corner of Broadway and 42nd that never seems to have the right permits. I don't mind the occasional vendor, but this one looks completely unlicensed and it's right next to a busy subway entrance. Can someone look into this?

I frequently walk by a newsstand on 8th Avenue between 32nd and 33rd that doesn't have any visible licenses. It just feels so sketchy, especially when they sell goods like cigarettes and lottery tickets. I’m worried about who’s operating that stand.

There’s a pop-up newsstand near my office on 9th street that’s been there for months without any signs of a permit or license. It’s frustrating because it blocks the sidewalk and seems to take advantage of pedestrian traffic. Can someone check if they’re operating legally?

I’ve noticed a newsstand on 3rd Avenue that doesn’t seem to have any proper licensing. It’s been there for weeks now and looks like it’s just set up without any oversight. I’m concerned about the safety and legality of what they're selling.

label: Lost Property. Other. Passport
complaints: I can't believe I lost my passport on the subway last night. I have no idea how it slipped out of my bag, but I’m really stressed out because I was only a few stops away from home when I realized it was gone. Can someone please help me figure out how to report it?

I think I left my passport at that restaurant on 5th Avenue last Saturday. I called them, but they said they haven’t seen it. I'm flying out in two weeks and need assistance with what to do next. This is a real mess!

I misplaced my passport at a coffee shop in Brooklyn last week and, despite checking daily, it hasn’t turned up. I’m panicking because I’ve got an upcoming trip and can’t afford any delays. How do I go about replacing it quickly?

I’m really worried because I lost my passport during a visit to Central Park yesterday. I retraced my steps and checked with everyone I could, but no luck. Can someone guide me on what steps to take next?

label: Mobile Food Vendor. Plumbing. Plumbing Inadequate
complaints: I live on the corner of 45th and 9th, and there’s a food truck that parks here every day. The smell of sewage has been unbearable lately, especially when it's busy. It's really disturbing my family’s meals and even makes it hard to breathe when we’re outside.

There’s a vendor on my block whose setup is leaking water all over the sidewalk. It’s been like this for a week, and now it’s attracting all sorts of pests. I’ve had to dodge puddles and it’s making it hard for my kids to play outside safely.

Why does the hot dog cart on West 34th always smell like something died? The plumbing situation has to be addressed because it’s driving me and my neighbors crazy. We can’t open our windows without gagging!

Can someone please check the taco truck by 8th Avenue? The plumbing issues are getting worse and the area smells rancid. It’s hard enough navigating through crowds, but dealing with the stench is too much.

label: Food Establishment. Dishwashing/Utensils. Not Cleaned/Stored Properly
complaints: I ordered takeout from a local restaurant last night and when I opened the container, the utensils were still dirty. I can’t believe they would send out food with unwashed forks and spoons, it’s really unacceptable!
I visited a cafe yesterday and noticed the cutlery was not properly cleaned. I found dried food on some of the forks. It's really off-putting, and I won’t be going back until I see some improvements.

Last week, I picked up some food from a diner and the plastic utensils they gave me were all smudged and looked like they hadn’t been washed. This is the second time in a row this has happened; it’s just gross!

I went to a food truck downtown, and the disposable utensils were clearly used before. They should be more careful about hygiene, especially with the pandemic still a concern. I had to find a cafe nearby to wash my hands after using those.

label: Consumer Complaint. Other Store (Non-Food). Price Not Posted or Inaccurate
complaints: I went to a store on 34th Street and saw a pair of shoes marked $50, but when I got to the register, they rang up at $75. I tried to ask the cashier about it, but they just shrugged it off. It's really frustrating when prices aren't consistent.

Yesterday, I bought a jacket at a boutique in the East Village, and it had a tag that said it was 50% off, but when I paid, I was charged full price. I feel like I was misled, and now I'm stuck with this higher price.

I was shopping at a store in Brooklyn and noticed that many items were not marked with prices. It took forever to find someone to help me, and when I did, they said they were too busy to check. This is such a hassle when I just want to know what's on sale.

I went to a store in Soho and saw a clearance sign, but when I picked up some items, they didn't have any prices on them at all. I wasted so much time finding an employee to help, and it turns out none of the items were on sale. Totally misleading!

label: Maintenance or Facility. Unsecured Facility. Building/Facility Unlocked
complaints: I just walked past the community center on 5th Avenue, and the doors were wide open. It's 10 PM, and it doesn't seem safe to leave it like that. Can someone please check it out?
I noticed that the library on 43rd Street has been unlocked since this afternoon. It’s a bit concerning, especially with all the valuables inside. Can someone secure it?
The gym facility on 34th Street was left completely unlocked this evening. I went by around 8 PM and saw no one around. It's a recipe for trouble, please send someone to lock up!
I’m really worried because the entrance to the local park building has been open all day. I walked by at noon and again now at 6 PM, and it’s still unattended. It shouldn't be left open like this.

label: Outside Building. Roof Door/Hatch. Leaking
complaints: There’s a leak coming from the roof hatch in the back of my building, and it’s been dripping inside the stairwell for the past few days. It’s starting to create a mess and I’m worried about mold forming if it doesn’t get fixed soon.
Can someone please check out the hatch on the roof? It’s leaking water down into the hallway every time it rains, and I’m concerned about the damage it's causing to the walls and ceiling.
I've reported this before but the roof door is still leaking. Water is pooling on the steps, and it’s slippery and dangerous. I need it addressed as soon as possible because it’s only getting worse.

Every time it rains, water seeps in through the roof hatch. I noticed it leaking for the last week, and now it’s starting to smell musty in the stairwell. This is unacceptable for a building in the city.

label: Traffic Signal Condition. Aps. Hanging
complaints: The pedestrian signals at the intersection of 42nd Street and 8th Avenue are hanging loose and don't make any sound when activated. It's been like this for over two weeks, and it's really unsafe for people trying to cross, especially those with visual impairments.

I noticed that the auditory signals at the corner of Broadway and 34th Street are broken again. It’s been several days now, and without them, it’s hard for visually impaired pedestrians to cross safely. Can we get this fixed as soon as possible?

The sound signal for crossing at 5th Avenue and 23rd Street is out of order, and the signal is hanging precariously. This has been an issue for at least a week now, and I’m worried someone might get hurt trying to cross there.

I've been waiting for the auditory pedestrian signals at the intersection of 3rd Avenue and 45th Street to be repaired. They're hanging and not functioning at all. It's been over ten days, and I see people struggling to know when it's safe to cross.

label: Consumer Complaint. Process Server. Goods or Services Not Delivered
complaints: I ordered a new couch from a local store over a month ago, and I still haven't received it. I've called them multiple times, and they keep giving me the runaround. I just want my money back at this point.

I purchased a pair of shoes online and selected express shipping, but they were supposed to arrive last week and still haven't made it. It's frustrating because I needed them for an event that already happened.

I hired a cleaning service for this past weekend and they never showed up. I made arrangements and even took the day off work, only to wait all day with no communication. Now my apartment is a mess, and I feel cheated.

I signed up for a subscription box that promised delivery at the beginning of each month. It's now almost the end of the month and I still haven't received anything, nor can I get a hold of customer support. This is beyond disappointing.

label: Lost Property. Clothing/Glasses. Coat
complaints: I left my favorite coat on the bus last night around 8 PM, and I can’t stop thinking about it. It’s a dark green parka with a fur-lined hood. I really hope someone turned it in!
I think I lost my black wool coat somewhere in the subway on my way to work this morning. If anyone finds it, please let me know. It was really cold, and I can't afford to replace it!

I accidentally left my coat in a restaurant in the West Village last week and the staff haven’t seen it. It’s a light blue overcoat, and it had my keys in the pocket, so I’m really anxious about it. Can you help me find it?
I was at Central Park and I think I left my red raincoat on a bench. I walked away to take some pictures and didn’t realize until later. It’s a bummer because it was a gift from my grandmother.

label: Consumer Complaint. Car Wash. Overcharge
complaints: I went to the car wash on 5th Avenue yesterday and they charged me $40 for a basic wash. I was told on the phone it would be $25. This feels like a scam, and I'm really frustrated that they changed the price without any explanation.

I just got my car washed on 42nd Street, and I was shocked when they charged me almost double what I usually pay. I expected to pay around $30, but they rang me up for $55. I won’t be returning there again!

I had my car cleaned at a place near my apartment last week, and they added extra charges for services I didn’t even ask for. I thought I was paying $20 for a wash, but my bill came to $45 with all these 'add-ons'. It’s so dishonest!

I went to a car wash last Saturday, and I clearly asked for a basic wash. They ended up charging me for additional services I didn’t want or need. I only wanted a simple wash, and I ended up paying way too much. This should be addressed.

label: Maintenance or Facility. Graffiti or Vandalism. Restroom/Comfort Station
complaints: I was at the park yesterday and noticed that the restrooms were covered in graffiti. It’s really disappointing to see such disrespect for our public spaces, especially since kids use that area.
The comfort station by the playground has been vandalized for weeks now, and the restroom is in terrible shape. It makes it hard to enjoy the park when I have to deal with such a filthy environment.
Why is the restroom in the community center completely tagged with graffiti? It hasn’t been cleaned in ages, and the odour is unbearable. Can someone please take care of this?
I went to use the public restroom at the beach and found it covered in spray paint and with broken fixtures. It’s such a shame because it’s a popular spot, and people deserve better facilities.

label: BEST/Site Safety. Safety Netting/Guard Rails - Damaged/Inadequate/None (Over 6 Stories/75 Feet)
complaints: I live on the seventh floor of my building and there's scaffolding on the next block that has been up for weeks without any safety netting. I worry about debris falling and hitting someone below, especially when the wind picks up.

The construction site across the street has no guard rails, and it's been really stressful watching workers up there without any safety measures. I can't help but think about how dangerous it is for the pedestrians walking by.

My apartment overlooks a building site that's at least eight stories high. It's been over a month since I first noticed the lack of safety netting, and I'm really concerned for the people walking below. Can someone please check on this?

I’ve seen workers on that tall scaffolding without proper safety netting or guard rails. It’s really unsettling to watch them work, knowing that a single misstep could lead to serious injuries for them or worse for anyone walking by.

label: Bike Rack. Missing
complaints: I just noticed that the bike rack outside my apartment building on 12th Street is completely gone. It was there just last week, and now there’s nowhere for me to lock up my bike safely. Can this get fixed soon?

There used to be a bike rack on 5th Avenue near the park, but it's missing now. I rely on it every day when I commute to work, and I feel uneasy locking my bike to a pole instead. It’s been gone for over a month—what’s going on?

I’m really frustrated because the bike rack at the corner of Broadway and 34th Street has disappeared overnight. I parked my bike there last night, and now I have no place to secure it. This is a busy area, and we need proper bike parking!

Can someone please tell me why the bike rack at 10th and 23rd is missing? I’ve been trying to find a safe spot to park my bike for days now, and it’s impossible. It's just causing a lot of inconvenience for all of us cyclists.

label: Flooring/Stairs. Stairs. Landing Platform Broken
complaints: I just got home and noticed that the landing platform on the stairs in my building is completely broken. It's dangerous, and I'm worried someone might trip and fall. This needs to be fixed ASAP!

For the past week, the landing at the top of the stairs has been unstable. It shakes every time someone steps on it, and it's making me really anxious every time I use the stairs. Can someone please come and take a look?

The landing platform leading to my apartment is cracked and uneven. I've even seen several neighbors struggling to balance on it. It feels like an accident waiting to happen. Please get this repaired soon!

I've been living here for over three years, and the landing platform has always been a bit off, but it’s worse than ever now. It creaks loudly underfoot and has started to separate from the wall. This is a serious safety issue that needs immediate attention.

label: Plumbing. Sewer. Broken Or Blocked Drain
complaints: I've been dealing with a blocked drain in my apartment for over a week now. The water backs up every time I try to wash dishes, and it’s starting to smell awful. I really need someone to come take a look at it soon!
There’s a terrible sewage smell coming from my bathroom that’s been lingering for days. I can’t even use it comfortably and I fear it’s going to get worse if it’s not addressed quickly.

I noticed that the drain in my kitchen has been clogged for about two days, and nothing I do seems to help. It’s making it really hard to cook, and I can't afford to let the situation go on like this much longer.

I live on the third floor and my neighbor below says their ceiling is leaking because of a blocked drain in my unit. I didn’t even know I had a problem until they told me! I need someone to check this out ASAP before it causes more damage.

label: Sidewalk Condition. Sidewalk Staircase
complaints: The steps leading up to my building are completely cracked and uneven. I’ve almost tripped multiple times when coming home late at night. Something needs to be done before someone seriously injures themselves.

I live on the Upper West Side, and the staircase by the entrance of my apartment has loose tiles. I’m worried that one of the kids in the neighborhood is going to fall and hurt themselves. Can someone please fix it?

The staircase in front of my building is a disaster. The concrete is crumbling, and I’ve seen elderly neighbors struggle to navigate it. It’s been in this condition for months now and it's really dangerous.
There are large cracks and weeds growing in the steps outside my apartment. I constantly see people stumbling as they walk by. It’s embarrassing for our building, and it needs immediate attention.

label: Traffic Signal Condition. Cable. Operating Improperly
complaints: I've noticed that the traffic lights at the intersection of 42nd and 8th Avenue are malfunctioning. They change too quickly, causing a lot of confusion and danger for both vehicles and pedestrians. It’s been like this for over a week now!

The traffic signal on 5th Avenue and 34th street is stuck on red. I’ve seen multiple cars running the light because it’s been red for too long. It's creating a risky situation during peak hours. Can someone please look into it?
Can you please do something about the traffic light at Broadway and 47th? It's been flickering and sometimes doesn't change at all. I almost got hit while trying to cross the street this morning!

There’s an issue at the traffic signal on 3rd Avenue by 14th Street; it keeps going out, and cars are getting backed up during rush hour. This has been happening for the last couple of days and it’s really causing delays and frustration.

label: Food Establishment. Letter Grading. Letter Grade Incorrect
complaints: I just went to my favorite diner, and I noticed they have a 'C' grade posted, but I swear they were an 'A' last month! Can someone please check if this is a mistake? I really don't want to eat somewhere that doesn't meet standards.

I saw a restaurant down the street had its letter grade changed recently, but the place seems perfectly clean. I think something's off. Can someone look into what happened? It has been bothering me since I eat there often.

I’m confused about the grading of the café I went to last week. I’ve been there a lot and it always felt clean and safe. How did they go from an 'A' to a 'B'? I’d like to know more about their inspection results.

My favorite Italian place has an 'A' grade, but I heard from a friend that they’re under scrutiny now. It was packed last night and I felt a bit uneasy. Can you verify their current standing before I go back?

It's really unfair how some people set up their stuff on the benches in the park and treat it like their own private lounge. It makes it tough for everyone else who wants to use the space.

label: Maintenance or Facility. Recreation Center. Restroom/Shower
complaints: The women's restroom at the local rec center has been out of order for a week now. It's inconvenient and discouraging for those of us who come to work out regularly. Please fix it soon!
I was at the gym yesterday and the showers were freezing cold. I couldn't even wash off after my workout. This is unacceptable, can someone please address the hot water issue?

I brought my kids to the community center for a swim yesterday, but the family restroom was filthy – no soap in the dispenser and the floor was really dirty. It made the whole experience unpleasant for us.
I've noticed that the restrooms at the park don't get cleaned regularly. I went there on Sunday and there was no toilet paper and overflowing trash. It’s a shame because my kids love playing there.

label: Consumer Complaint. Used Car Dealer. Warranty Not Honored
complaints: I bought a used car from a dealer two months ago, and they promised a warranty on the engine. Now my car won't start, and they're saying they can't honor the warranty. This is so frustrating!
I’m really upset because the used car dealership sold me a vehicle with a 30-day warranty, but when I took it back for repairs, they refused to fix it. I've only driven the car a handful of times!

After purchasing a used car, I discovered issues that were supposed to be covered by the warranty. I reached out to the dealer, but they are ignoring my calls and emails. I feel completely taken advantage of.

I bought my car a little over a month ago and was assured that any mechanical issues would be covered by the warranty. I now have a check engine light on, and the dealership is claiming they can't help me. What a scam!

label: Animal in a Park. Domestic Strays. Cat
complaints: I was at Central Park yesterday and noticed a stray cat wandering around near the playground. It looked very thin and seemed scared, I’m really worried it might get hurt.
There’s a cat that’s been hanging around the benches in Washington Square Park for over a week now. It looks like it doesn’t have a home, and I’m afraid it might be sick.
I saw a scruffy cat in Prospect Park, just lying under a tree. It was meowing non-stop and seemed distressed. Can someone please help it?
There’s a stray cat at the entrance of Fort Greene Park that looks lost. I saw it there twice this week, and it just sits there looking for food. I hope someone can check on it.

label: Highway Sign - Dangling. Exit/Route
complaints: I was driving on the FDR this morning and noticed a highway sign that's hanging by a thread. It's swaying dangerously and could really pose a risk to drivers. Someone needs to address this immediately before someone gets hurt.

There's a sign for the exit to the Verrazzano that's dangling precariously over the road. I saw it last night, and it’s still hanging there. It’s a big safety hazard, especially for people who are unfamiliar with the area.

I commute on the highway every day, and the sign for the upcoming exit is not only down low but also swinging in the wind. It's been like that for at least a week. It’s really distracting and could cause an accident!

At the intersection of 42nd and 10th, there’s a highway sign that’s almost completely broken and just swinging in the breeze. It’s been this way for days now, and it makes navigating that area really confusing. Please get this fixed soon.

label: Mobile Food Vendor. Smoke/Odor. From Unit Creating Nuisance
complaints: There's a food truck parked outside my apartment on 34th Street, and the smell of grilled meat is overpowering. It's been like this for the last three days, and I can't open my windows without feeling nauseous.

I live near a vendor who seems to be cooking late at night. The smoke from their grill is seeping into my apartment, and it's hard to breathe sometimes. This has been going on for a week now, and I'm starting to get really frustrated.

Every time I come home from work, there's this strong odor from a food cart on the corner of 8th Avenue. It's so bad that I can't even enjoy my balcony. I've noticed it getting worse over the past couple of weeks.
The constant smell of fried food from that vendor at the end of my block is unbearable. I’ve tried speaking to them, but nothing changes. This has been an ongoing issue for at least a month now.

label: Food Establishment. Dishwashing/Utensils. Utensils/Equipment Dirty
complaints: I just got takeout from that new restaurant on 5th Street, and the silverware they gave me was still dirty. I had to wash my fork before I could eat my meal. This is unacceptable, especially during a pandemic!
I ordered delivery last night, and my utensils were grimy with food residue. I can't believe they would send out dirty forks and spoons. It really made me lose my appetite!

I went to that diner on Elm Avenue this morning and noticed that the knives and forks were not clean. I asked for some new ones, but the replacement was just as bad. I think they need to take better care of their dishwashing.

Yesterday, I picked up food from the place on Maple Street and when I got home, the utensils were still greasy and had food stuck on them. It made me worry about their hygiene practices. This needs to be addressed.

label: Beach/Pool/Sauna Complaint. Beach/Pool Water. Other (Explain Below)
complaints: I took my kids to the beach yesterday, and the water was filthy. There was so much trash floating around that we couldn't even enjoy a swim. It seems like no one is cleaning it up regularly.
We visited the pool at the community center last weekend, and the water was murky and smelled awful. It was so uninviting that we left after only a few minutes. Can someone please check on this?

I've noticed that the water at the local beach hasn't been clear for weeks. It's frustrating because I live nearby and would love to relax by the shore, but the water quality is really off-putting. Something needs to be done!

I went to the public pool on West 20th Street, and the water was shockingly cold. We were only able to stay for a short time before we had to leave because the kids were shivering. It’s unacceptable for a city pool not to maintain proper temperatures.

label: Window Guard. Tenant Refusal. Tenant Refused Install Request
complaints: I've been trying to get my landlord to install window guards for months now, especially since I've got young kids, but they keep refusing. It’s really stressful knowing how dangerous it can be without them, and I just want my home to be safe!

My neighbor’s apartment has windows that are wide open, and they have small children playing near them. I've asked them multiple times to put window guards in, but they refuse. I’m worried it’s only a matter of time before something happens.

I live on the fifth floor and my windows are so flimsy. I asked my landlord to install window guards, but they keep making excuses. Honestly, I feel like I can’t relax at home knowing they won’t take this simple step for safety.

Every time I bring up window guards, my landlord brushes it off. I can’t sleep at night knowing my kids are at risk with those unsecured windows. I wish they’d just take this seriously instead of ignoring my requests.

label: Consumer Complaint. Hotel or Motel. Overcharge
complaints: I checked into a hotel last week, and I was charged an extra $100 that wasn’t mentioned during booking. It’s really frustrating to see hidden fees appear at checkout, especially after I had already planned my budget for the trip.

I booked a room for two nights at that hotel down on Broadway, and when I arrived, they charged me a different price than what was confirmed. The front desk didn't seem to care, and now I’m out of pocket more than I anticipated.

Last month, I stayed at a place in Manhattan that advertised one rate, but I was billed significantly more when I got my credit card statement. I feel ripped off and need guidance on how to challenge this overcharge. It's really disappointing!

I thought I found a great deal at a hotel, but they added on so many extra charges that it ended up being way more expensive than I planned. It would be nice if they were more transparent about their pricing upfront.

label: Missed Collection. Trash
complaints: I can't believe it's Wednesday and my garbage hasn't been picked up yet. It’s starting to smell and attract rats in the alley behind my building. This has happened twice this month already!
I put my trash out last night, but it never got collected this morning. I’ve had to deal with the smell all day and now I have to keep it in my apartment. This is really frustrating!
Our trash was supposed to be picked up yesterday, but nothing happened. We can't keep living like this with the overflowing bins in front of our building!

It's been nearly 24 hours since my scheduled garbage pickup. My bags are piling up outside, and I’m worried about attracting pests. This isn't the first time this has happened, and it's getting really annoying.

label: Maintenance or Facility. Graffiti or Vandalism. Bike Path/Greenways
complaints: I've noticed that the bike path along the Hudson River is covered in graffiti, and it really takes away from the beautiful view. It needs to be cleaned up as soon as possible, especially with more people out biking now that the weather is getting warmer.
There’s a lot of graffiti on the bike lane near 42nd Street and 8th Avenue. It’s been there for weeks and is making the area look really neglected. Can someone please take care of this?

I ride my bike daily through Central Park, but I'm really frustrated with the amount of vandalism I've seen recently. The path is tagged with spray paint in several spots, which is both unsightly and makes me feel unsafe. It’s been like this for over a month now. Please do something about it!

The bike path by the Williamsburg Bridge is marred with graffiti on all sides. It’s so bad that I’m embarrassed to take visitors there. This has been a problem for at least a couple of weeks, and it really needs to be addressed.

label: General Construction/Plumbing. Landmark Bldg - Illegal Work
complaints: I live near the corner of 5th and Main, and I've noticed a lot of construction happening at the landmark building across the street. It seems like they’re doing some work without the proper permits. It's been really disruptive, especially with all the noise and dust for the past two weeks.

There’s a crew working on the old cathedral down the block, and it doesn’t look like they have permission to be doing this. I've seen them tearing down parts of the structure during the day and it's concerning. I hope someone can look into it because it just doesn’t seem right.

I can't believe the construction happening at the historic church is allowed. They’re working late into the night and the noise is unbearable. Plus, I've seen workers doing things that seem really unsafe and definitely not up to code. This needs to stop!

For the past month, I've been watching the renovations at the former post office and it feels like they're jumping through hoops to avoid regulations. There’s constant banging and I’m worried they’re damaging the building’s integrity. Could someone check if they’re following the rules?

label: Consumer Complaint. Tow Truck Company. Unlicensed
complaints: I came out of my apartment yesterday to find my car towed without any warning. The company didn't have any identification, and when I asked their driver for information, he wouldn't give me any. I'm really concerned about the legitimacy of this towing service.

I parked my car legally, and somehow it got towed while I was at work. When I found the tow truck and confronted the driver, he couldn't provide me with any proper documentation. This feels really sketchy and I just want to know what’s going on.

My neighbor's car was towed by a company that looked suspicious. The driver said they were towing cars for street cleaning, but I’ve never seen any signs around here about that. I think they might not be properly licensed and it's a problem for all of us.

Two days ago, I watched as a tow truck took away a car parked in front of my building. The truck had no visible company name or registration, and the driver seemed pretty evasive when I asked about their authority. I feel like this may not be a legitimate operation.

label: Consumer Complaint. Pawnbroker. Overcharge
complaints: I visited a pawn shop on 5th Avenue last week and felt totally cheated. They charged me way more than what I expected for a simple gold bracelet. I didn’t realize until I got home that I could have sold it for much more elsewhere!

I took my old camera to a pawn shop on Broadway to sell it, and they offered me a price that was half of what it’s worth. It felt like they were taking advantage of me just because I was in a hurry. I should have done my research first, but it still doesn’t feel right.

I went to a pawn shop yesterday and was shocked at the markup they had on their jewelry. What they quoted me for a pair of earrings seemed insane! I’ve seen similar items for a fraction of the price online. It's really frustrating to see such dishonesty.

I recently pawned a vintage watch at a local shop, only to find out later that I was underpaid for it. When I checked online, the value was significantly higher. I wish there was a way to hold these shops accountable for their pricing.

label: Plumbing. Boiler. Broken
complaints: My building's boiler has been broken for the last three days. It's freezing in my apartment and the landlord hasn't responded to my messages. We really need some heat, especially with this cold snap going on.
The hot water has been out in my building since the weekend. I can't take a proper shower, and it's really affecting my work routine. I hope someone can come take a look at this soon.

For the past week, our radiators have been making loud banging noises and they're not heating properly. I’ve tried to get the super to fix it, but it seems like he's too busy. This is really disruptive at night.
I'm calling to report that our boiler has been leaking water in the basement for a while now. It’s creating a mess and I’m worried about mold. Can someone please come inspect it?

label: Street Light Condition. Multiple Street Lights Out. Location Type: Residential Address
complaints: I've noticed that the streetlights on my block have been out for over a week now, and it feels incredibly unsafe walking home at night. Can someone please come and fix them?
The streetlights on my street have been out for several days, and it's making it really difficult for us to see when we come home late. It’s concerning, especially with kids in the neighborhood.
All the streetlights on my street are out, and it's been like this for days. It's pitch dark, and I'm worried about safety when I walk my dog in the evening.
I’ve been walking my kids home from school, and there are multiple streetlights out on our block. It’s so dark that it’s hard for drivers to see us. This needs attention as soon as possible.

label: Consumer Complaint. Drug Store or Pharmacy. Advertising False or Misleading
complaints: I went to the pharmacy on 5th Avenue because they had a sign advertising a buy one, get one free deal on vitamins, but when I got to the register, the cashier told me it was only for certain brands, which were all out of stock. Totally misleading!

I bought a product that was advertised as 'on sale' when it was actually the regular price. I feel ripped off, especially since I specifically checked the ad before making the trip. Why do they do this?

I just picked up a prescription at the drugstore on Broadway, and they had a huge sign claiming all cold medications were 20% off, but when I checked out, only a few items were included. I feel like they should be more transparent with their promotions.

I saw an online ad for a special discount on skincare products at the local pharmacy, but when I went in to purchase them, the manager said there was no such discount available. I wasted my time and money, and it’s frustrating!

label: Lost Property. Bag/Wallet. Money Clip
complaints: I think I left my brown leather wallet in the back seat of an Uber last night. I tried contacting the driver through the app but haven't heard back. It's really frustrating because it had all my cards and ID in it.

I lost my black canvas bag on the subway this morning, and it had my laptop inside. I've checked lost and found, but I want to know if there's a way to report it officially or if someone might have turned it in.

A few days ago, I was at a coffee shop in the East Village and left my money clip on the table. I called them, but they said they didn't find anything. I’m worried about my cash and cards being used by someone else.

I misplaced my small leather wallet at a bar last weekend and really need help finding it. I've gone back twice, and no one has seen it. It's not just the money but my ID and other things that I can't replace easily.

label: Consumer Complaint. Laundromat. Contact Sign Not Posted
complaints: I just went into the laundromat on 5th Avenue, and I noticed there was no contact sign posted anywhere. It's really frustrating because I wanted to ask a question about their machines, but I had no idea who to talk to. Can they please put up a sign?

I was at the laundromat on 10th Street today and couldn't find any contact information posted. I had an issue with a dryer and needed someone to help, but there was no one around and couldn’t find a way to report it. This is really inconvenient!

I rely on the laundromat near my apartment, but they don’t have any contact information displayed. I had a problem with my laundry yesterday, and I wouldn’t know who to call if it happened again. Can someone please address this?

The laundromat on Broadway doesn't have a contact sign up, and it's been like this for weeks. It’s tough to get help when there's no one supervising the machines, and I think they really need to fix this for their customers.

label: Animal in a Park. Animal Waste. Other
complaints: There's a dog park near me, and lately, it's become unbearable because some owners aren't cleaning up after their pets. The smell is really bad, especially in the warmer weather, and I don't want to let my kids play there anymore.

I've been running in Prospect Park every morning, and I've noticed an alarming amount of dog waste on the trails. It's getting hard to navigate without stepping in something, and it really ruins the experience for everyone trying to enjoy the park.

Can someone please do something about the amount of animal feces in Central Park? It feels like every few feet, there's a pile. It's not just unpleasant; it's also a health hazard around the playgrounds.

I took my kids to a local park yesterday and was appalled by how much dog waste was left everywhere. It makes the place feel dirty and unwelcoming. Owners really need to take responsibility for their pets.

label: Mobile Food Vendor. Permit/License/Certificate. Vending of Unapproved Items
complaints: I live near the park on 5th Avenue, and there's a food cart selling items that I'm pretty sure they're not allowed to sell. It's been there every day for the past week, and it's starting to annoy me. Can someone please check if they have the proper permits?

For the last two months, there's been a mobile vendor in front of my apartment selling snacks that look suspiciously unapproved. The smell is great, but I’m concerned they don’t have the right licenses to operate. It’s making the sidewalk super crowded, too!

I’ve noticed a food cart on Broadway that’s selling things that aren’t typically allowed, like homemade items. On top of that, it’s been parked in front of my favorite coffee shop for several weeks now, making it difficult for customers to get in and out. Can you please investigate?

There’s a vendor on the corner of 42nd and 7th who seems to be selling items they shouldn’t. I’ve seen the same cart there every day this week, and I’m pretty sure they don’t have all the necessary permits. It’s a nuisance with all the foot traffic it causes.

label: Tattooing. Minor Received Tattoo
complaints: I recently went to a tattoo shop in the East Village and the artist seemed rushed. I ended up with a tattoo that looks nothing like what we agreed on. I'm really upset and feel like I wasted my money.
I got a small tattoo last week, and it hasn’t healed properly at all. It’s really red and painful, which I don’t think is normal. I’m worried that it might get infected or something worse.
I went to have my tattoo done in Brooklyn, and the shop was dirty and disorganized. The equipment didn’t seem sanitized, and I’m honestly really concerned about the hygiene standards there.
My friend got a tattoo from a shop in Astoria, and it faded within just a few days! It was supposed to be permanent, and now it looks like a blur. That’s just unacceptable for the price we paid.

label: Consumer Complaint. Tax Preparation Services. Tax Documents Not Filed
complaints: I went to a tax preparation service last month and they promised to file my taxes by April 15th. Now it’s almost tax day and I can’t get in touch with them. I’m really stressed out about this.
I paid a company to handle my tax preparations, but I’ve been trying to follow up for weeks and they haven’t filed my documents yet. It’s really concerning, and I’m worried I’ll miss the deadline!

After choosing a tax service based on their advertising, I’m now sitting here without any confirmation that they filed my taxes. I'm on hold for the fifth time trying to get answers and feel completely ignored.

I went to a local tax preparer and they assured me that everything was in order. I've just learned that my documents haven't been filed, and I'm feeling frustrated and anxious about the potential penalties.

label: Consumer Complaint. Pedicab. Unlicensed
complaints: I was approached by a pedicab driver near Central Park, and he seemed really pushy about giving me a ride. When I asked for his license, he couldn't provide anything and just kept insisting. It made me uncomfortable, and I think people need to know about this.

This past Saturday, I was at Times Square and saw several pedicabs operating without any visible permits. It feels really unsafe to see so many unlicensed drivers weaving through traffic with tourists who likely don't know better. Can someone look into this?

I had an unsettling experience with a pedicab near Union Square. The driver didn't have any identification on him and charged me an outrageous fare. It doesn't seem right that unlicensed drivers are allowed to operate in such a busy area.

There’s a pedicab that always parks outside my building on the Upper West Side. I've noticed the driver doesn’t have any permits displayed, and sometimes he gives rides to families with small kids. It worries me that people might be getting into an unregulated vehicle.

label: Violation of Park Rules. Unauthorized Climbing. Tree
complaints: I just saw a group of kids climbing up the trees in the park again. It's getting dangerous, and I'm worried someone will fall and get hurt. Can someone please enforce the rules?

Every weekend, I witness people scaling the trees in the park like it's a playground. It's disrespectful to the environment, and I can’t believe it’s allowed to continue. This has been going on for weeks!

There have been adults climbing the large trees in the park lately, and it's really concerning. I’ve noticed this happening for about a month now, and I think it’s time someone steps in before someone gets injured.

I was walking my dog this morning, and I saw several teenagers climbing the trees in the park. It’s so frustrating, especially since I know there are signs that say it’s not allowed. This behavior has been going on for days, and I think the park needs more supervision.

label: Consumer Complaint. Restaurant. Customer Data Shared Without Consent
complaints: I just found out that my email address and order history from a restaurant I ordered from are being shared without my permission. I didn't sign up for any newsletters or data-sharing agreements, and I feel really uncomfortable about it.

I used my credit card at a local eatery, and now I'm getting spam emails from a company I've never heard of. I'm worried that my personal information has been compromised, and I want to know how they got it.

I went to a restaurant last week, and I later received a marketing email from them. I never agreed to have my info shared like that. It's frustrating because I just wanted to enjoy my meal without my data being passed around.

I noticed that a restaurant I frequented has started sending me texts about promotional offers. I never gave them my phone number or consented to receive messages. It’s unacceptable to use my data without asking me first!

label: Damaged Tree. Branch or Limb Has Fallen Down. Park (High Traffic Area)
complaints: There’s a large branch that fell from a tree in Central Park near the Bethesda Terrace. It’s partially blocking the path and is a hazard for people walking by, especially with all the tourists around today. Can someone come clean it up?

I was jogging through Prospect Park this morning and noticed a huge limb had fallen from a tree right in the middle of the main path. It’s causing people to walk around it, which is pretty dangerous considering how busy it gets. Please send someone to remove it as soon as possible!

I work near Bryant Park and there’s a broken branch hanging dangerously low from one of the trees. It’s been like this for a few days now, and I’m worried it’ll fall on someone. Can someone check it out before it hurts someone?

I just walked through Tompkins Square Park and saw a large section of a tree that collapsed onto the playground area. It's just lying there and could be a serious risk for kids playing nearby. I’d appreciate it if someone could address this soon.

label: Consumer Complaint. Gas Station Pumps. Measurement Inaccurate
complaints: I just filled up my car at the gas station on 8th Avenue and I swear the meter was off. I barely got a quarter tank, but it showed I used so much more. This isn’t the first time I've noticed it either!

Last week, I filled my tank at the gas station near Central Park and it seemed like I didn't get the amount of gas I paid for. I drove just a few blocks and my warning light came on. Can someone please check their pumps?

I’m really frustrated with the gas station on 42nd Street. I filled my tank and it took way more money than usual, but the gauge barely moved. I think they might be ripping people off over there. Something's not right!

I just left a gas station in Brooklyn and I feel cheated. The pump clicked off way too early, and I’ve never seen my tank so empty after a full fill-up. This problem needs to be looked into before more people get scammed.

label: Street Sign - Damaged. Speed Limit
complaints: I was driving down West 42nd Street and noticed the speed limit sign is completely bent over. It's dangerous because people might not realize they're going too fast. Can someone take a look at it?
The speed limit sign on East 3rd Street near the park is damaged and barely legible. I’ve seen cars speeding through that area lately, which is worrying. It really needs to be fixed ASAP.
There’s a speed limit sign on Hudson Street that’s been knocked down for days now. I’m concerned for the kids in the neighborhood since people drive way too fast there. Can someone get it replaced?

I drive past the speed limit sign on 10th Avenue near the construction zone every day, and it’s completely obscured by debris. It’s been like this for over a week, and I feel like it’s putting everyone at risk. Please address this.

label: Consumer Complaint. Locksmith. Refund, Return, or Exchange Refused
complaints: I hired a locksmith last week to help with a lockout situation, and they charged me an outrageous fee without doing the job properly. I've been trying to get a refund, but they won't respond to my calls or messages. It's frustrating!

I had a bad experience with a locksmith who promised me a reasonable rate but then charged me triple when he arrived. I contacted him for a refund, and he basically ignored my request. I feel scammed!

The locksmith I hired replaced my lock, and it broke just two days later. I reached out for a refund as they promised a warranty, but they are refusing to assist me. I'm really disappointed with their service.

I called a locksmith to fix my front door, and they charged me upfront. When the lock didn’t work properly afterwards, they refused to come back to fix it without additional payment. This is unacceptable; I just want what I paid for!

label: Consumer Complaint. Mobile Food Vendor. Price Not Posted or Inaccurate
complaints: I just bought a hot dog from that vendor on 42nd Street, and he charged me $6 when the sign clearly states $3. I feel ripped off and would like some help with this.
Yesterday, I picked up lunch from a food cart near Central Park but was shocked when I was charged $8 for a sandwich that was listed at $5 on the menu. It feels misleading, and I want to report this.
I grabbed a slice of pizza from a mobile vendor in Brooklyn, and they charged me $5, but the price on the sign was only $2. I’d like to know how to address this issue, as it doesn’t seem fair.

I just encountered a food truck in the East Village that had prices listed, but when I went to pay, they added extra charges and it turned out to be much more than what was displayed. I’d like to report this vendor for being dishonest.

label: Mobile Food Vendor. Food Source/Protection. Food from Unapproved Source
complaints: I keep seeing this food truck parked on my block, but I don’t think they have permits. It’s been there every evening this week, and I’m worried about the safety of the food they’re serving.
There’s a mobile food vendor in front of my apartment every day, but it looks like they don’t have any proper licenses. I’ve seen them using old, worn-out equipment that just feels unsanitary.

The taco truck around the corner has been selling food for months, but I never see them get inspected. I can smell the grease from my window, and I’m worried about the quality of the food they’re offering.

For the last few weeks, there’s this food cart that pops up at lunchtime on my street. I noticed they don’t have any visible health department certification. It’s making me uncomfortable eating close to them.

label: Consumer Complaint. Electronics Store. Refund or Return Policy Not Posted
complaints: I just left the electronics store on Broadway and I was really frustrated. They don’t have their return policy posted anywhere, and when I asked the sales associate, they seemed confused. It's not fair to consumers if we don’t know what the rules are before we buy something.

I recently bought a laptop from a store on 42nd Street, and I didn't realize until I got home that they don't have their return policy visible. I wanted to return it because it wasn’t what I expected, but now I’m stuck with this expensive item. They need to make that information clear!

I went to an electronics store in the Flatiron District and noticed they have no signage about returning items. When I inquired, the staff were unhelpful and couldn’t give me a straightforward answer. It’s really annoying and leaves customers in a tough spot.

I was at an electronics shop on 5th Avenue last week, trying to figure out their return policy. I couldn’t find it posted anywhere and the employee didn’t help much. It’s frustrating when you want to make a purchase but don’t know the terms. They should really put up clear guidelines for customers.

label: Consumer Complaint. Tour Guide. Goods or Services Not Delivered
complaints: I booked a tour with a company last week and paid in full, but the guide never showed up today. I've called their number several times, but no answer. This is really frustrating because it ruined my whole day.

I scheduled a walking tour for a group of friends, but nobody arrived at the meeting spot. We waited for over an hour and there was no communication from the tour operator. I feel scammed and would like a refund.

My family and I were supposed to take a ferry tour this afternoon, but when we got to the dock, we found out it was canceled without any notice. I want to know how to get our money back and why they didn't notify us.

I had a reservation for a food tour this past weekend, but the company canceled it last minute and didn’t even bother to inform me. I had planned my whole day around it, and I’m really disappointed with their lack of professionalism.

label: Consumer Complaint. Smoking, Cigar, or Vape Store. Overcharge
complaints: I went to a vape shop in the East Village yesterday and they charged me way more than the price listed on the shelf. I’m not sure if it’s a mistake or if they’re just trying to cheat customers, but it feels really unfair.

I bought a cigar from a store in Midtown and the cashier charged me $15 more than the tag said. This isn’t the first time this has happened at that place, and I feel like I’m being ripped off every time I go there.

Last week, I visited a cigar shop in Brooklyn and noticed that I was charged significantly more than the advertised price. It’s frustrating to be misled like that, especially when I’m trying to support local businesses.

I was at a vaping store in Astoria and they tried to charge me extra for a product that was already overpriced. I mentioned it to them, and they didn’t offer any explanation. It’s just really annoying to deal with shady pricing practices.

label: Curb Condition. Defacement. Graffiti
complaints: There’s some really ugly graffiti on the curb in front of my building on 5th Street, and it’s been there for weeks. It makes the whole block look so rundown. Can someone please do something about it?
I live on Canal Street, and there’s graffiti all over the curb that’s just getting worse. I’ve tried cleaning it myself, but it just keeps coming back. It’s been like this for over a month!

The curb outside my apartment on Broadway has a lot of graffiti that's really detracting from the neighborhood. It’s embarrassing to have guests over and see that mess every time I come home. Can we get some cleanup here?

There’s spray paint all over the curb near the corner of 14th and 6th. It’s been there since before I moved in last month, and it’s starting to look like no one cares about this area. It would be great if someone could take care of it.

I received my food delivery today, and they charged me an extra $10 for a service fee that wasn't disclosed before checkout. I feel cheated and want to know how I can get my money back.

I just checked my bank statement after using a popular food delivery service, and they billed me $15 over what I agreed to pay at checkout. This seems ridiculous, and I can't keep paying these hidden fees.
Last week, I ordered some food for a small gathering using a delivery service, and they tacked on an unexpected $12 charge that wasn't mentioned anywhere. It's really disappointing.

label: Traffic Signal Condition. Vehicle Signal. Leaning
complaints: I've noticed that the traffic light at 5th Avenue and 34th Street is leaning to one side. It looks pretty unstable, and I worry it could cause an accident, especially during rush hour. Can someone please check it out?

The traffic signal at the corner of Main Street and Elm is tilted at an awkward angle. It’s been like this for over a week now, and I feel like it's really dangerous for drivers and pedestrians alike. It needs to be fixed ASAP!

There’s a traffic light at the intersection of Broadway and 42nd that’s been leaning for a few days. Whenever cars come to a stop, they seem confused about when to go. This isn't just annoying; it could lead to a serious crash if it isn’t straightened out soon!

Can someone please take a look at the traffic signal on 8th Avenue? It’s leaning so badly that it’s hard to tell if it's red or green. It’s been like this for about a week, and I’m concerned it might confuse drivers. Thanks!

label: Traffic Signal Condition. Veh Signal Lamp. Down
complaints: I was driving down 5th Avenue and noticed that the traffic light at 42nd Street is completely out. It was chaos with cars and pedestrians not knowing when to go. This has been like that since yesterday, and it’s really unsafe!

The traffic signal at the intersection of Broadway and 34th Street has been blinking yellow for over a week now. It’s causing confusion among drivers, and I’ve seen a few near-misses because of it. Can we please get that fixed?

Can someone please look at the traffic light on 6th Avenue where it crosses 23rd Street? It’s been dark for three days now, and I’m worried someone’s going to get hurt trying to cross. This is not okay!

I commute through the intersection at 42nd and 8th every morning and the traffic signal has been out for two days. It’s becoming a dangerous spot with cars not yielding to pedestrians. It really needs immediate attention.

label: Damaged Tree. Branch or Limb Has Fallen Down. Playground
complaints: I've just noticed that a large branch has fallen from the tree in our local playground. It's blocking the swings and could be dangerous for kids trying to play. This needs to be cleared immediately as it's been there since yesterday and I’m worried someone might get hurt.

There’s a huge limb down in the playground next to our apartment building. It fell during the storm a couple of days ago. The kids are playing around it, and it’s really unsafe. Can someone please come and remove it?

I walked my dog by the playground this morning and saw a fallen branch from one of the trees. It’s taking up half the play area, making it tough for the kids to enjoy the space safely. Could someone take care of this soon?

A big branch came down from the tree in the playground on Elm Street after last week’s storm, and it's just lying there. I’m worried it could hurt someone if it’s not removed. It’s been a few days already and I think it should be addressed quickly.

label: Maintenance or Facility. Graffiti or Vandalism. Fence
complaints: I've just noticed that the playground fence in our local park is covered in graffiti. It's really upsetting to see our community space being vandalized, especially since kids play there every day. I hope this can be addressed soon.

The fence around the high school has been defaced with spray paint for over a week now. It's not just an eyesore; it sends a bad message to the students and the neighborhood. Can someone please clean it up?

I walked past the community garden yesterday and saw that the fence has been tagged with some pretty aggressive graffiti. It’s disappointing because it takes away from the beauty of the area. Can we do something to remove it?

There’s a large section of the fence near the bus stop that has been vandalized with graffiti. It's been like that for at least a month now, and it makes the area feel unsafe. It would be great if someone could take care of it soon.

label: Street Sign - Dangling. School Crossing
complaints: I just walked by the school on Maple Avenue, and the crossing sign is hanging by a thread. It's really dangerous for the kids crossing there. I hope someone can fix it soon!

The school crossing sign at 5th and Main is dangling precariously. I noticed it yesterday, and it seems like it could fall at any moment. Please send someone to take a look before an accident happens!

There’s a crossing sign near the elementary school on Pine Street that's not properly secured. It’s swinging around and could easily hit someone! It has been like this for about a week now.
