complaints: The lights in the hallway of my building have been flickering for weeks now, and it’s really unsettling. I feel unsafe walking through there at night, and I’m worried it might be a fire hazard.
I live on the 3rd floor, and the overhead lights have been out since last week. It’s difficult to navigate the stairs, especially with groceries. Can someone please come fix them?
The lighting in the laundry room is so dim you can barely see the machines. I’ve almost dropped my clothes several times. It's been like this for over a month now, and it needs to be addressed.
Our communal porch lights haven't worked for over two weeks, making it very dark and unsafe at night. We need those lights fixed so we can use the space without feeling anxious about our safety.

label: Street Light Condition. Fixture/Luminaire Damaged. Location Type: Intersection
complaints: The streetlight at 5th Avenue and 14th Street has been flickering for the past week. It's really hard to see when crossing, especially at night.
I've noticed that the streetlight at the corner of 42nd and Broadway is completely out. It's been dark there for over a month now, and I'm worried about safety.
There's a broken streetlight at the intersection of 8th Avenue and 49th Street that has been out for several days. It makes that corner feel unsafe when it's dark outside.
The light at Houston and Wooster is broken again, and it seems like it’s been a problem for months. With all the traffic, it’s really dangerous for pedestrians.

label: Consumer Complaint. Other Store (Non-Food). Credit Card Total Price Not Posted
complaints: I just left the electronics store on 5th Avenue and noticed they didn’t post the total price for my purchase before I checked out. It was very frustrating to see a different amount charged to my card than what I expected!
I walked into a clothing store in SoHo, and they didn’t have the final price for my items displayed anywhere. I felt misled when I saw the charge on my receipt—something needs to be done about this!

I made a purchase at a boutique in the West Village and I was surprised to see a higher amount on my credit card than what I thought I was paying. They really should be more transparent about their pricing at the register.

After shopping at a local shop in the Upper East Side, I found that they charged me a different amount than I believed it would be based on what was shown in-store. This lack of clarity is a real issue that needs addressing.

label: Water Maintenance. Leak
complaints: I've noticed a steady water leak in front of my building on 5th Avenue for the past three days. It’s creating a hazardous condition with water pooling on the sidewalk, and I’m worried someone might slip and get hurt.

There’s a leak at the intersection of 8th Street and Broadway that's been going on for over a week now. The constant sound of dripping is driving me nuts, and it’s attracting mosquitoes. I really hope someone can come look at it soon.

I came home tonight to find a leak near my apartment, and it's causing water to drip down from the ceiling. This is the second time this month, and I can't keep living like this with water damage threatening my belongings.

This morning I noticed water gushing out from a fire hydrant that’s been opened for hours on 14th Street. It's wasting so much water, and the pressure is low for everyone else in the area. Can someone please come and fix it?

label: Water Quality. Taste/Odor, Sewer (QA5). Qa5
complaints: I've noticed a strange, musty smell coming from the tap water in my apartment for the past week. It's really off-putting and makes me hesitant to drink it or even use it for cooking.
The water from the faucet has a metallic taste that’s been bothering me for a few days. I’ve tried running the tap for a while, but it hasn’t improved at all.
Since last Friday, the water in my building has had a really strong chemical odor. I can't even wash my hands with it without feeling uneasy. Can someone please check what's going on?

I live in the East Village and the water has been tasting really odd lately—like a mix of dirt and something else. It’s been like this for about four days now, and I’m really concerned about what I’m drinking.

label: Mobile Food Vendor. Permit/License/Certificate. No Food Protection Certificate
complaints: I just walked by a food cart on 34th Street, and it didn't have any visible permits. I'm really worried about food safety since it seems like this vendor is operating without the proper licenses. Can someone check on this?

There’s a vendor on my block who sells hot dogs, but I noticed they don't have a food protection certificate posted anywhere. I don’t want to see anyone get sick from eating there, especially with how busy this area is. Please do something about this.

I went to grab lunch from a food truck that looked sketchy—no health inspection certificate was visible. It feels pretty unsafe to eat from a place that isn't certified. I really think someone should investigate these trucks a bit more.

Every time I walk past the food vendor at 5th Avenue and 8th Street, I notice they don't have the proper health permits displayed. I love street food, but I can't shake the feeling that this isn't safe. Can someone look into it?

label: Traffic Signal Condition. Aps. Turned
complaints: The pedestrian signal at the corner of 5th and Main has been malfunctioning. It keeps turning off unexpectedly, and it's really dangerous trying to cross the street when the light is out. Can someone please check on it?

I've noticed that the crosswalk signal at 42nd and Broadway isn't working at all. It turns on for a second and then goes off again, leaving pedestrians confused about when it's safe to cross. This has been happening for over a week now.

The traffic light at the intersection of 8th Avenue and 14th Street is stuck on red. I've seen several frustrated drivers and near collisions because of it. This has been happening during peak hours for almost three days now. It really needs urgent attention.

I live near the crosswalk at the corner of 23rd and Park and have been dealing with a broken pedestrian signal for weeks. It just flashes erratically, and it’s making it hard for kids to safely cross the street. Can someone please fix it soon?

label: Posting Advertisement. Vehicle
complaints: I live on 5th Avenue and I keep seeing these annoying flyers taped to every lamppost and mailbox. It's getting out of hand, and I don't understand why nobody's cleaning them up. It's just such an eyesore!

There's a car parked outside my building with a huge advertisement plastered all over it. It's been there for a week, and it's attracting a lot of attention. It’s also blocking my view when I’m trying to park. Can someone please check it out?

Every morning, I find new flyers stuck to the front of my apartment building. I’ve been trying to peel them off, but they just keep coming back. This has been happening for almost two weeks now, and it feels like I’m living in a billboard!

I couldn't believe my eyes when I saw a vehicle parked across the street with an obnoxious ad on it. It's been there for three days now, and it's driving me crazy. I wish people would clean up after themselves.

label: For Hire Vehicle Complaint. Driver Complaint - Passenger. Combined Pickups
complaints: I was waiting for my car and when it finally arrived, the driver had just dropped off another passenger. It took forever for them to juggle both of us, and I ended up being late for my meeting. Can’t they stick to one pickup at a time?
I ordered a ride and the driver picked up someone else right before me. We were crammed in the backseat, and it was really uncomfortable. This is not what I expected when I booked a private car!

This morning, my driver picked up a second passenger while I was already in the car. It was so cramped and awkward, and I didn’t feel safe. I just want a ride without the added stress of sharing with strangers.

I’ve had it with drivers picking up multiple riders. I was late getting to work today because the driver stopped to grab someone else who was blocks away. I don’t mind sharing a cab sometimes, but it shouldn’t happen when I’ve already booked a ride.

label: Street Light Condition. Lamppost Base Door/Cover Damaged. Location Type: Intersection
complaints: I've noticed that the base of the streetlight at 5th and 34th is completely damaged. It's been like this for over a week now and I’m worried someone might trip over it in the dark.

The lamppost at Broadway and 72nd is missing its base cover and it’s been that way for about a week. It’s not only an eyesore but could pose a safety risk if someone gets too close.

label: Food Establishment. Water. No Running Water
complaints: I've been living in my apartment for over a week now and I still don't have any running water. It's becoming really inconvenient, and I have no idea when it’s going to be fixed. I just want to be able to wash my hands without having to go to my neighbor's place.

I woke up this morning to find that we have no water again. This has happened multiple times in the last month. It's frustrating because I have a job and I need to shower and get ready. I don't know how much longer I can deal with this.

I'm calling because the water in my building has been out since last night. I have two small children, and it’s impossible to manage without running water for basic needs like cooking and cleaning. Please let me know when this will be resolved.

The water in my apartment has been sporadic all week, and I can't even make coffee in the morning without it cutting out. It’s really affecting my daily routine. I need to know how soon I can expect this to be fixed.

label: Maintenance or Facility. Structure - Outdoors. Sign
complaints: The street sign at the corner of 5th and Main has been missing for weeks, and it's really confusing drivers and pedestrians alike. Can someone please replace it soon?
I've noticed that the parking sign on our block is completely faded and barely legible. I’m worried that people will park without knowing the rules, which could lead to issues.

The construction signage on 42nd Street has fallen over and is blocking the sidewalk, making it difficult for people to pass. This has been a hazard for the past couple of days. Can you send someone to fix it?

There’s been a broken streetlight at the intersection of 8th and Broadway for over a month now, and it’s pitch dark there at night. It's unsafe for everyone walking home. Please send someone to replace it.

label: Animal-Abuse. In Car. Cat
complaints: I just saw a cat locked in a hot car on Main Street, and it looks really distressed. The windows are rolled up and it's been there for over half an hour. Can someone do something before it gets too hot?
There's a small gray cat in a parked car on East 12th, and it's been meowing loudly for the last 20 minutes. The windows are barely cracked. I'm really worried about its safety in this heat.
I can't believe what I just saw! A poor cat is stuck in a vehicle on 5th Avenue, and the owner hasn't come back in over an hour. It looks like it's struggling to breathe. Please help it!
I saw a cat alone in a car near the grocery store on Broadway. It's been there for almost 45 minutes now, and the temperature is rising. Someone needs to intervene before it gets hurt.

complaints: I just bought a pair of shoes from a store on Broadway, and the scale they use to weigh my package was totally off. It showed way more than it should have, and now I feel like I paid more than I needed to. Can someone check that out?

Last week, I tried to return an item at a store in the West Village, but their scale said my package was heavier than it truly was. It made my return such a hassle. They really need to fix or replace that scale!

I was at a store on the Upper East Side, and the scale they used gave me a reading that didn't make any sense. I weigh my items at home, and there’s a huge difference. This has to be addressed because it’s affecting customers.

label: Maintenance or Facility. Graffiti or Vandalism. Bench
complaints: I just walked past the bench on 3rd Avenue and it's covered in graffiti. It really ruins the look of the neighborhood, and I can't believe nobody has taken care of it yet.
The bench at the park near my apartment is a mess. There's graffiti all over it, and it makes the whole area feel unsafe. This has been like this for weeks and it’s really disappointing.
I noticed that the bench by the subway entrance has been vandalized with awful graffiti. It’s so uninviting, especially for families coming through. Can someone please clean it up?

Every time I sit on the bench at Central Park, I notice new graffiti. It's really getting out of hand, and it makes me think twice about using the public spaces. This has been ongoing for a while now.

label: Consumer Complaint. Electronics or Appliance Repair. Contract or Billing Dispute
complaints: I took my laptop to a local repair shop three weeks ago, and they said it would only take a week to fix. Now, I can't get in touch with them, and they haven't returned my calls. This is really frustrating because I rely on my laptop for work.

I had my refrigerator repaired just last month, and they promised me a warranty on the parts. Now, a few weeks later, it's making a weird noise again, and they won't respond to my emails about the warranty. I'm starting to feel like I've been cheated.

I paid for a new oven installation, and they didn't show up on the scheduled day. After calling them multiple times for an explanation, I finally got someone who promised to come out a week later. It's still not done, and I’m left without a working oven.

I signed a contract for a home theater system installation, but they keep delaying the service. It's been over a month since my initial appointment, and I'm tired of waiting. I just want my money back at this point—this has been entirely too stressful.

label: Sanitation Worker or Vehicle Complaint. Inappropriate Behavior. Snow Laborer
complaints: I just witnessed a sanitation worker throwing trash around instead of picking it up—I can't believe the attitude. It's disrespectful to everyone in the neighborhood trying to keep things clean!

I saw a city snowplow driver swerving all over the road and nearly hit a parked car. It’s scary to think how these workers are handling city vehicles when they could pose a danger to residents.
There’s a sanitation worker who is constantly rude when asked to help with questions about pickup times. It just makes it harder for us to plan, and their behavior is really uncalled for.

label: Water Conservation. Wasting Faucets,Sinks,Flushometer,Urinal,Etc. - Other (CWO). Cwo

The sink in the community center is leaking badly and drips every few seconds. It’s been like this for over a week now. I can't believe no one has done anything about it; it's a huge waste of water.

label: Consumer Complaint. Department Store or Megastore. Credit Card Total Price Not Posted

I had a frustrating experience the other day when I tried to check out. The register didn’t show my total, which left me confused and worried about being overcharged. Please fix this!

complaints: I just went to the local grocery store and noticed that prices on basic items have skyrocketed. A loaf of bread is now almost $5! This is outrageous, especially when people are struggling to make ends meet.

I bought a few groceries yesterday and was shocked when I saw the total. It feels like they are price gouging on essentials. I can't afford this, and I know many others are feeling the same way. Something needs to be done.

complaints: I bought a space heater from my local bodega last week, and just realized it doesn't have any safety features like an automatic shut-off. I'm really worried about fire hazards, especially with winter coming up.

I was in a deli on the Upper West Side and noticed they were selling cheap space heaters that don’t meet safety standards. It’s concerning to think families might be at risk with items like that on the shelves.

I saw space heaters for sale at my neighborhood deli, but they seem poorly made and lack essential safety features. I can’t believe they’re allowed to sell these. It feels really unsafe, especially with all the cold weather coming.

complaints: I ordered takeout from a restaurant last night, and when I opened the container, I noticed a strange chemical smell coming from the food. I didn't eat it, but I’m really worried it could have been harmful. It was really unsettling, and I’d like to know if that place is safe.

label: Ferry Complaint. General Complaint
complaints: I rely on the ferry to get to work every morning, but it's been running late consistently for the past week. Today, it was more than 20 minutes behind schedule, and I missed an important meeting because of it.

complaints: The playground at 10th and B is a mess right now. There’s still snow piled up everywhere and I can’t let my kids play safely. It’s been over a week since the last storm, can someone please clear it?

I live near the bus stop on Broadway and every time I go by, I see these oversized signs violating the aesthetic of the neighborhood. It’s such an eyesore, and it just keeps getting worse. Why is this allowed?

I just drove through Times Square and noticed that all the traffic signals are dead. There was no control over the cars and it’s only a matter of time until something happens. This needs urgent attention!

label: Consumer Complaint. Newsstand. Sidewalk Blocked
complaints: I can't believe how often this newsstand on my block is blocking the sidewalk. It's been like this for weeks, and I have to walk in the street just to get around it!

Every morning, I have to navigate past a newsstand that sprawls out onto the sidewalk. It makes it really difficult for people with strollers or wheelchairs to get by. Could someone please address this?

I understand that newsstands need to sell their products, but the one on 5th Avenue is taking up way too much space on the sidewalk. It’s been like this for a month, and it’s a real hazard during busy times.

I was almost knocked over by a bicyclist trying to squeeze past a newsstand that's taking up half the sidewalk near my apartment. This has been happening for days, and it’s making it hard for anyone to walk through.

label: Consumer Complaint. Gift, Novelty, or Souvenir Store. Goods Damaged or Defective
complaints: I bought a mug from that souvenir shop in Times Square, and when I got home, I noticed it was cracked. It was a gift for my sister, and now I have to scramble to find something else last minute!

I picked up a keychain from a street vendor last week, and it fell apart the first time I tried to use it. I was really disappointed, especially since I wanted to have something nice from New York City to remember my trip.
I ordered a t-shirt from a store in the West Village, and after one wash, it shrank to half its size. I thought it was supposed to be good quality for the price I paid. Now I can't wear it!
I went to a novelty shop and bought a snow globe as a souvenir, but it was leaking as soon as I took it out of the box. I would expect some kind of quality control for items like that.

label: Consumer Complaint. Ticket Seller. Refund, Return, or Exchange Refused
complaints: I purchased tickets for a concert that got canceled, and now the seller is refusing to give me a refund. I've been on hold for hours trying to resolve this and it's incredibly frustrating.
I bought tickets for a play, but when I arrived, they said my seats were double-booked. The seller will not refund my money and insists I should've known it was a risk. This is unacceptable!

I tried to return a ticket I bought online because of a scheduling conflict, and the seller told me it's their policy not to issue refunds. I feel cheated since I reached out within the timeframe they suggested.
I bought tickets for an event that got postponed, and when I asked to exchange them for a future date, they simply refused. I feel like I'm being taken advantage of here.

label: Consumer Complaint. Restaurant. Scale Inaccurate or Broken
complaints: I went to the deli on my corner this afternoon and noticed their scale was off. I weighed my bagel and it said it was a pound, but it clearly wasn’t even close. I ended up paying way more than I should have!

I just bought a sandwich from that new hot spot in the neighborhood, and their scale said my lunch weighed twice as much as it should have. I feel like I’m being ripped off every time I go in there. Can someone check it?

Last week, I ordered a pastry from the bakery on Main Street, and the scale they used was completely broken. It showed a pound for something that felt much lighter, and I ended up overpaying. I’m frustrated and wondering if this happens often?

I went to get some cheese at the market, and their scale showed my selection weighing more than it should. I asked the clerk about it, and he just shrugged it off. This is unacceptable; I want accurate measurements when I shop!

label: Lost Property. Jewelry. Watch
complaints: I lost my grandmother's watch while walking in Central Park yesterday around noon. It's very sentimental to me, and I'm really hoping someone has found it and can return it.
My watch went missing during my commute on the subway this morning. I remember checking the time, but when I got off at my stop, it was gone. It was a gift from my father, and I’m devastated.

Last night, I realized that my wristwatch is missing after visiting a café in the West Village. I’m not sure if I left it there or if it fell off, but it’s a unique piece that’s extremely valuable to me.
I think I left my vintage watch at the gym in Chelsea. I was there for about two hours and noticed it wasn't on my wrist when I got home. I've called them, but no luck so far.

label: Consumer Complaint. Bodega, Deli, or Convenience Store. Credit Card Total Price Not Posted
complaints: I just went to the corner deli and they didn't have the total price displayed for my credit card transaction. It left me unsure of how much I was actually being charged, which is really frustrating when you're trying to keep track of your expenses.

I visited my local bodega earlier today and noticed that they don't show the total on the credit card machine before you pay. It feels like I'm playing a guessing game with my money. Can they please post the total before finalizing the charges?

Every time I go to this deli around the block, I have to ask how much my total is because they never display it on the credit card reader. It's a small thing, but it makes the shopping experience annoying, especially during busy hours when I don't want to hold up the line.

I just went to buy a few items at the convenience store, and once again, I had no idea what my total was before I swiped my card. It feels like a sneaky practice and leaves you in the dark about your spending.

label: Consumer Complaint. Garage or Parking Lot. Cars Parked on Sidewalk or Street
complaints: I've noticed several cars parked on the sidewalk near my apartment on 8th Avenue. It’s been an issue for weeks now, and it’s making it difficult for pedestrians, especially those with strollers or wheelchairs, to get by safely.

Every morning when I leave for work, I have to navigate around a car that’s blocking part of the street on 15th Street. It’s been parked there for days and is causing a lot of congestion during rush hour.

There’s a parking lot on my block that has been overflowing with cars. They’re now taking up the sidewalk, and I feel unsafe walking my dog there with all the traffic. It’s been like this for over a month. Can someone please address this?

I live near Central Park, and there are always cars parked on the sidewalks near the entrances. I have to step into the street to get around them, especially in the evenings. It’s incredibly frustrating and feels dangerous.

label: Consumer Complaint. Hardware Store. Goods Damaged or Defective
complaints: I bought a power drill from that hardware store on Main Street, and it wouldn't turn on right out of the box. I can't believe I wasted my time and money on this. Can someone check the quality of the items they're selling?
I picked up a set of paintbrushes last week, and when I opened the package, I found that some bristles were already falling out. This is unacceptable—now I have to return them and waste more time.

I ordered a set of garden tools, and when I got home, I discovered the shovel had a huge dent and the handle was wobbly. I'm really disappointed; I expected better from this store. Who wants to deal with defects?

I tried to assemble a shelving unit I bought and found that several pieces were damaged. I don’t have time to fight with broken products, so I’d appreciate it if someone could look into their inventory quality control.

label: Consumer Complaint. Travel Agency. Contract Dispute
complaints: I booked a trip with a travel agency three months ago and they haven't returned any of my calls or emails. I'm really worried because my departure is in less than two weeks and I still don't have my tickets or any information about my itinerary. This is extremely frustrating!

The travel agency promised a full refund for a canceled trip due to the pandemic, but it’s been over four months and I still haven’t received any money back. It's unacceptable to leave customers hanging like this, especially during such a difficult time.

I had a horrible experience with a travel agency that misrepresented the costs of my vacation package. They charged me extra fees that were never disclosed at the time of booking. I feel cheated and can't get them to respond to my complaints!

I was told I would receive a confirmation of my travel plans within 48 hours, but that was two weeks ago. I've tried contacting the agency multiple times and now I'm worried I won't have a place to stay when I arrive at my destination. This is really stressful.

label: Industrial Waste. Oil Spill Into Basin/Sewer - Small (IABS). Iabs
complaints: I was walking by the East River and noticed there was a strong smell of oil. I can see some slick on the water's surface. This has been going on for a few days now and I’m worried about the environmental impact.

I live near the industrial area by the Brooklyn waterfront, and the other day, I saw a small oil spill near the sewer grates. It's been there for over 24 hours. It’s disgusting and I’m concerned about it leaking into the water.

Every time it rains, I smell a pungent oil odor coming from the storm drains on my block. It's been like this for weeks, and I’m anxious about what it's doing to our waterways. Someone needs to take a look at this.

I found some oily residue on the ground near the park by the river. It looks like an industrial spill, and it’s been there for a few days. I’ve seen kids playing nearby and I think this is really dangerous.

label: Traffic Signal Condition. Fixture(S). Hanging
complaints: I was driving down 42nd Street this morning and noticed a traffic light hanging at an odd angle. It’s really hard to see whether it’s red or green from my car, and I worry it might cause an accident if it isn't fixed soon.
There’s a traffic signal on 5th Avenue that’s been hanging for days now. It’s extremely dangerous, especially during rush hour when drivers are confused about when to stop or go.
I live near the intersection of 8th Avenue and 23rd Street, and the traffic light is hanging precariously. Every time I drive through, I feel like it’s about to fall. Can someone check on that?

The traffic signal at 14th Street and 7th Avenue has been hanging down for over a week. Drivers are ignoring it because it’s hard to tell when it’s functioning, and it’s causing a lot of near misses. Please address it urgently!

label: Street Light Condition. Lamppost Knocked Down. Location Type: Residential Address
complaints: I just walked by the corner of 5th and Maple, and I noticed that the lamppost has been knocked down for days. It’s really dark there at night, and I’m worried someone might trip or get hurt.

There’s a lamppost lying on the sidewalk outside my apartment on 12th Street. It fell during the storm last week and I can't believe no one has come to remove it. It’s making the area feel unsafe, especially after sunset.

I live on Elm Avenue, and the streetlight in front of my building has been down for over a week. It’s been really frustrating to walk home in the dark, and I feel like it’s a safety hazard. Can someone please do something about this?

The streetlight at the intersection of 8th and Pine has been down since last week. It’s pitch black there at night and I’ve seen a few near-misses with pedestrians and cars. This needs urgent attention before someone gets hurt.

label: Street Light Condition. Lamppost Missing. Location Type: Highway
complaints: I was driving home last night and noticed a lamppost is missing on the highway. It's really dark in that area and it makes it really dangerous for drivers. Can someone please address this?

The absence of a street light on the highway near exit 23 has been a problem for weeks now. I've seen several near-misses because it's so hard to see, especially at night. This needs to be fixed ASAP!
I commute on the highway daily, and I can't believe how dark it is where the lamppost is gone. I feel unsafe driving there; it would be nice if this could get some attention before someone gets hurt.

There’s a section of the highway where a lamppost is completely missing, and it creates a really hazardous situation at night. I’m worried about the safety of everyone using that part of the road. Please replace it soon.

label: Water Quality. Taste/Odor, Bitter/Metallic (QA3). Qa3
complaints: I've been noticing a really strong metallic taste in my tap water for the past week. It’s so bad that I’m hesitant to even cook with it or use it for brushing my teeth. Can someone please look into this?
The water in my building has had a strange, bitter smell lately. I first noticed it two days ago, and it hasn't improved. It's starting to make me feel uneasy about using it.
For the last few days, the tap water has had a weird metallic flavor. I tried letting it run for a while, but it hasn't changed. I can't even make a decent cup of coffee with it!

I don’t know what’s going on, but the water from the faucet has this awful, bitter quality to it that’s really concerning. It started around three days ago, and it’s not getting any better. We need some help with this immediately.

label: Traffic Signal Condition. Vehicle Signal. Missing
complaints: I was coming home from work yesterday, and I noticed that the traffic light at the corner of 3rd Avenue and 45th Street is completely missing. It’s so dangerous for everyone trying to cross. Can you please send someone to fix this?

The traffic signal at 7th Avenue and 12th Street has been gone for weeks now. I’ve seen so many near-misses while drivers are confused about who has the right of way. This really needs immediate attention before someone gets hurt!

I live near the intersection of Broadway and 51st and the traffic light is missing. It’s been like this for over a week, and traffic is chaotic. Cars are speeding through where the light should be. Please do something about it soon!

I don’t know what’s going on, but the traffic light at 14th Street and 9th Avenue has been out for days. As a pedestrian, it’s terrifying to cross, especially with the amount of cars on that street. Can this be addressed urgently?

label: Street Light Condition. Lamppost Base Door/Cover Open. Location Type: Park
complaints: I was walking through the park this evening and noticed that one of the lampposts has its base cover wide open. It looks like a hazard and could be dangerous for kids playing nearby. Can someone please fix this?
There’s an open cover on the base of the lamppost in the park near the playground. I’m worried someone might trip or hurt themselves. It’s been like that for a few days now. Can it be addressed?
The lamp post in the middle of the park has an exposed base cover. I’ve seen dogs sniffing around it and it seems like a safety concern. This should be taken care of as soon as possible!
I noticed the lamppost base in the park is open and it’s been that way for about a week. It’s not just an eyesore; it’s unsafe for families who frequently visit. Please send someone to secure it.

label: Traffic Signal Condition. Aps. Install
complaints: I've noticed that the pedestrian signals at the corner of Main Street and 5th Avenue are malfunctioning. It’s been days since they’ve worked properly, and I feel unsafe crossing that street.

The traffic signal at 10th and Broadway has been stuck on red for over an hour this morning, causing a backup that stretches for blocks. This is ridiculous and very frustrating for drivers trying to get to work.
Could someone please check the crossing signals at West 42nd Street? They’re not audible and I’ve seen several people struggling to navigate the crosswalk safely, especially those with disabilities.
I live near 23rd and 8th Avenue, and the pedestrian signals are often not working. It seems to happen at least once a week, and it makes it really hard to cross safely during rush hour.

label: Street Light Condition. Lamppost Knocked Down. Location Type: Park
complaints: The streetlight by the entrance of Central Park at 59th Street has been knocked down for over a week now. It's really dark in that area at night and I feel unsafe walking through there.
I noticed that the lamppost near the playground in Prospect Park is completely down. It's been like this for days, and without the light, I worry about my kids playing in the evening.
The streetlight on the path leading to the lake in Brooklyn's Prospect Park has been knocked over and is still lying on the ground. It's been nearly two weeks, and it's really dark there at night.
There's a broken lamppost in Riverside Park near West 72nd Street. It's been down for at least a week and I can hardly see anything on my evening jogs. It's quite unnerving.

label: Traffic Signal Condition. Post. Need Utility Verify
complaints: The traffic light at the corner of 5th Avenue and 42nd Street is completely out. I’ve seen several near misses today because drivers are confused. This is a busy intersection, and it’s been like this for hours!

Can someone please check the traffic signal on 10th Street and Broadway? It’s been flashing yellow for the last few days, and drivers aren't stopping. I’m really worried about the safety of pedestrians here!

I don’t know what’s going on with the traffic light at 8th Avenue and 23rd Street, but it’s stuck on red. Cars are just driving through, and it’s causing a backup. It’s been like this since this morning!

There's a traffic signal at the intersection of Madison Avenue and 34th Street that’s malfunctioning. It keeps switching from green to red too quickly, causing chaos. It's been happening for a week now, and it needs urgent attention.

label: Maintenance or Facility. Grass/Weeds. Grass - Needs to be Cut
complaints: The grass in the park by my apartment has grown so high that it's hard to even see the paths. I've noticed it like this for weeks now, and it's starting to look like a jungle. Can someone come by and cut it?

I live near the community garden and the grass is out of control. It's almost up to my knees! It’s not only an eyesore, but I’m worried that it’s attracting bugs. This has been like this for over two weeks now.

The lawn in front of the building has been neglected for far too long. It’s completely overgrown, and I can barely walk through it without stepping on weeds. This really impacts our building's appearance, so I’d appreciate some action on this soon.

Every time I walk my dog past the park, I’m reminded how badly the grass needs cutting. It’s becoming a nuisance and takes away from the beauty of the area. It's been like this for more than a month now, and it's getting frustrating.

label: E-Scooter. Damaged or Vandalized. Lime
complaints: I just walked by the corner of 5th and Main, and there's a Lime scooter that's been completely vandalized. It's lying on the ground, and I’m worried someone might trip over it as it’s right on the sidewalk.
There’s a Lime scooter parked outside my apartment that’s been damaged for over a week. It looks abandoned and it’s taking up space on the sidewalk. Can someone please do something about it?

I don’t know who is responsible for these scooters, but the one parked near my block has been in really bad shape. It's missing a wheel and is just leaning against the wall. It’s an eyesore and could attract more vandalism if it stays there.

I live near Central Park, and there’s a Lime scooter that has graffiti all over it. It's been like this for days now and it's really affecting the view. Can someone arrange to have it removed or cleaned?

label: Taxi Complaint. Driver Complaint - Non Passenger. Unauthorized Pick-Up Location
complaints: I just saw a taxi stop in the middle of the street on Fifth Avenue and pick someone up, totally blocking traffic. This happens way too often and it's really dangerous for everyone trying to get by.

I was walking on my way to work when a yellow cab pulled over directly in front of the café. It wasn’t exactly a designated pick-up spot, and it made it really hard for pedestrians to get through safely.
Can someone do something about how these taxis are picking up fares at random spots? I watched one pull over on the sidewalk at 42nd Street today and nobody could get around. It's ridiculous!

Every morning, I see taxis stopping wherever they please along Park Avenue to pick up passengers. It's frustrating and creates a mess on the road. Can't they follow the rules and stop where they’re supposed to?

label: Municipal Parking Facility. Sign Defect - Garage
complaints: I just drove by the parking garage on 8th Avenue, and the entrance sign is completely burned out. It took me forever to figure out if it was even open; can someone please fix that?
The sign at the parking garage on West 34th Street is broken and doesn't light up at night. It's really confusing for drivers looking to park, especially during busy hours.

Could someone look into the sign at the parking garage on 42nd Street? Half of the letters are missing, and it makes it hard to know if the garage is full or not. This has been an issue for weeks now.
I parked at the garage on 57th Street last night, and the sign is so faded you can barely read it. It shouldn't be that hard to know what the rates are. This needs to be addressed ASAP.

label: Highway Condition. Unsafe Worksite
complaints: I was driving on the highway this morning and saw a construction area that wasn't properly marked. It's really confusing and makes me feel unsafe. Can someone please get out there and put up better signs?

There's a section of the highway that has been under construction for weeks, and it looks like they're not even working on it. The barriers are all over the place, and I feel like I’m navigating a maze every time I pass through. It’s frustrating and dangerous!

I commute daily and the ongoing roadwork on the highway is creating a serious hazard. The cones and detours are poorly placed, and I’ve seen several near-misses due to drivers not knowing what to expect. Can we get this sorted out?

I just drove through a construction zone on the highway, and it was a mess. There were no clear signs and the road conditions were terrible. It’s hard to tell where you’re supposed to drive, and I don’t want to see anyone get hurt because of this.

label: Lost Property. Jewelry. Necklace
complaints: I lost a silver necklace with a unique pendant while walking in Central Park yesterday afternoon. It means a lot to me, and I'm really hoping someone might have found it.
I think I left my gold necklace at the café on 10th Street around 3 PM. I went back to check, but it wasn’t there. I’d appreciate any help tracking it down.
I lost a sentimental necklace on the subway last night between the 3rd Avenue and 14th Street stations. I didn't realize until I got home, and I'm really upset about it.
Can anyone please help me? I lost a family heirloom necklace while shopping in SoHo. It’s been over two hours since I realized it’s gone, and I have no idea where to start looking.

label: Traffic Signal Condition. Cable. Hanging
complaints: There’s a cable hanging dangerously low at the intersection of 42nd Street and 8th Avenue. I almost hit it while driving yesterday, and I’m really worried someone might get hurt if it doesn’t get fixed soon.

I’ve noticed that a cable is hanging down at the traffic light on 3rd Avenue and 20th Street. It’s been like this for over a week now. Can someone please come and check it out before it causes an accident?

This cable hanging over the traffic signal at 5th Avenue and 14th Street has been a concern for days. It’s low enough that it’s distracting drivers and could definitely cause a problem. Please send someone to take care of it!

There’s a cable hanging loose by the traffic signal at West Broadway and Canal Street. It’s been there for two weeks and it’s getting lower every day. This is a major safety hazard, especially with all the pedestrians around. Can someone address this?

label: Consumer Complaint. Hotel or Motel. Core Staff Not Directly Employed
complaints: I stayed at a hotel in Midtown last weekend, and the staff seemed overwhelmed and unhelpful. I waited for over 30 minutes just to check in and when I asked for assistance, they were rude and dismissive. It really ruined my first night in the city.

I booked a room at a hotel near Times Square, but when I arrived, they informed me that my reservation was lost. I had to wait for them to find me alternative accommodation, which took forever and left me feeling stranded after a long day of travel.

The housekeeping at the hotel I stayed in was non-existent. I was there for four nights, and my room was only cleaned once, despite multiple calls. It’s unacceptable to pay that much and not have basic services like cleaning provided regularly.

I was really disappointed with my recent hotel stay in the East Village. The staff acted like they were doing me a favor by answering my questions. I’ve stayed in many hotels in NYC, but this was the worst service I've experienced.

label: Street Sign - Missing. Do Not Enter
complaints: I want to report a missing Do Not Enter sign on the corner of 5th and Main. Drivers are getting confused and it's really dangerous, especially with all the kids in the neighborhood.

There's no Do Not Enter sign at the intersection of Elm St and 10th Ave, and I've seen a number of cars drive into oncoming traffic. This has been a problem for over a week now, and it's getting worse. Can someone please fix it?

I thought it was just me, but I’ve noticed the Do Not Enter sign at Broadway and 34th is completely gone. It's been like that for at least a few days, and I’m really worried about the accidents that could happen if it’s not replaced soon.

The missing Do Not Enter sign at 8th Avenue and 22nd Street has made traffic a nightmare. I’ve almost been hit several times trying to cross, and it’s putting everyone’s safety at risk. This needs urgent attention!

label: Consumer Complaint. Employment Agency. Payment Demanded Up-Front
complaints: I just got off the phone with an employment agency that asked me for payment before they even got started on helping me find a job. It feels really shady, and I thought that was illegal in New York. Can someone look into this?

I went to an employment agency yesterday, and they demanded that I pay a fee upfront to access their services. I thought agencies should get paid only when they find you a job. This doesn’t sit right with me, and I want to report it.

I was approached by an employment agency that insisted I pay them a fee upfront for their services. I’ve been looking for work for ages, and I can’t afford to pay them without any guarantee. This is just exploitation, and I need help!

I’m really concerned about this employment agency I contacted. They want me to pay them before they even start looking for jobs for me. I feel like they’re taking advantage of desperate job seekers like me. Please check into this situation.

label: Air Quality. Air: Odor, Sweet From Unknown Source (AZ1). Az1
complaints: I just wanted to report a strange sweet smell in the air around my building on 5th Avenue. It's been really strong for the last few hours and I'm worried it might be harmful. Can someone check it out?

For the past few days, there's been an odd sweet odor wafting through my neighborhood near Central Park. It’s so strong that I can smell it inside my apartment, and it's making me feel uneasy. Please investigate this issue.

There’s a persistent sweet smell outside my kitchen window that’s been bothering me since last night. It’s very unusual, and I can't figure out where it’s coming from. I’m concerned about what it might be!

I live near the East River and every evening around this time, I notice a sweet smell in the air that feels kind of chemical. It’s been happening for weeks now and I’d really like to know what's causing it.

label: Consumer Complaint. Department Store or Megastore. Cash Payment Not Accepted
complaints: I went to the big store on 34th Street hoping to buy some essentials, but they wouldn't accept cash. It was frustrating because I only had cash on me, and it seems unfair for them to turn away customers like that. This needs to change!

Last night, I stopped by the local megastore to grab some groceries and was told they no longer accept cash payments. I understand the reasoning, but it made my shopping trip really inconvenient and stressful. Not everyone uses cards!

I tried to pay for some clothes at the department store in Brooklyn with cash and was told they stopped accepting it, which I find ridiculous. I don’t always carry my debit card, and it feels like they’re catering to only a small group of customers. What about the rest of us?

I visited the store on Fifth Avenue yesterday and was turned away because I wanted to pay in cash. This is unacceptable! They should have a cash option for us shoppers who prefer it, especially in a city as diverse as this one.

label: Consumer Complaint. Laundromat. Broken Machine Not Labeled
complaints: I just went to my local laundromat and one of the machines ate my quarters. It didn’t have a sign saying it was out of order, so now I’m out $3 and my clothes are still dirty. This is really frustrating!

I tried to use a washing machine at my laundromat last night, but it was broken. There was no label indicating it was out of service, and I wasted half an hour waiting for it to start. Can someone please fix it and put a sign up?

I went to do my laundry this morning, but one of the dryers has been out of order for days and it’s still not labeled. I ended up having to wait for a machine that actually works. This is getting ridiculous!

I just wanted to wash my clothes, but the machine I picked just didn’t work and there was no notice on it. It’s really disappointing when you make time to do laundry and end up wasting it on a broken machine.

label: Traffic Signal Condition. Controller. Damaged
complaints: The traffic light at the corner of 5th and Main has been blinking yellow for days now, making it extremely confusing for drivers and pedestrians alike. It feels dangerous out there, and I'm worried someone is going to get hurt.

Can someone please fix the traffic signal at Broadway and 42nd Street? It's been stuck on red for hours, causing a massive backup. Commuters are losing their patience and it's creating chaos around here.

I've noticed that the traffic light on 10th Avenue near the park is completely out. Cars are still speeding through, and I saw a few near misses today. This is definitely a hazard that needs urgent attention, before someone gets hit.

The signal at 23rd Street and 8th Avenue has been broken for the past week. It makes it impossible to cross safely, and I've seen so many frustrated drivers ignoring their red lights. It's a nightmare for everyone trying to get around.

label: Food Establishment. Food Protection. Unwashed Raw Food Served
complaints: I just got back from the new sushi place on 23rd and was horrified to find that the fish tasted off, and I could see bits of dirt on it. I really hope I don't get sick from eating there!
I ordered a salad from a deli in my neighborhood and found unwashed lettuce that had dirt clinging to it. It's absolutely disgusting, and I can't believe they would serve food like that!

Last night, I had dinner at a local restaurant and noticed the raw vegetables on my plate looked grimy. I really feel like they need to be more careful about cleaning their food before serving it. It's off-putting!
I went to grab some takeout from a place around the corner yesterday, and the raw chicken had visible residue on it. I didn’t eat it, but I’m worried about the safety standards at that place.

label: Consumer Complaint. Gas Station Pumps. Fuel or Octane Rating Mislabeled
complaints: I filled up my car at that gas station on 5th Avenue yesterday, and my car started sputtering after a few blocks. I think they mislabeled the fuel. I put in premium and I'm pretty sure it was regular. This is really frustrating!

I just bought gas at the station on 42nd Street and my engine has been making weird noises since. I checked the pump, and I suspect they charged me for mid-grade when I selected premium. I need my car to be reliable, and now I'm worried about the damage!

Last weekend, I went to fill up my tank at the gas station on Broadway, and I noticed that the octane rating at the pump didn’t match what was posted. I didn't realize until I was halfway home that my car requires higher octane. I can't afford unexpected repairs!

I stopped at a gas station near Central Park this morning, and when I got home, my car started acting up. I can't help but think it’s because the fuel wasn’t what it claimed to be. Can someone please check the pumps for accuracy?

label: Traffic Signal Condition. Pedestrian Sign. Damaged
complaints: I was crossing at 5th Avenue and 42nd Street this morning and the pedestrian signal was completely out. It was really dangerous because cars were zooming through and no one knew when to cross. Can someone fix it?

The pedestrian light at the corner of 14th and 1st has been broken for over a week now. With all the traffic, it’s hard to know when it’s safe to cross. It’s a busy intersection and I worry someone might get hurt!

Can someone take a look at the pedestrian sign on Main Street near the park? I noticed it's been damaged and the light doesn’t work properly. I was waiting for it to turn, but it just blinked for a second and went out. Really frustrating!

I just walked past the intersection at 34th and Lexington, and the pedestrian signal was completely knocked out. People were crossing in the middle of traffic, and it felt chaotic. This needs urgent attention before someone gets hit.

label: Consumer Complaint. Used Car Dealer. Cars Parked on Sidewalk or Street
complaints: I just got back from running errands, and I can’t believe the number of used cars parked all over the sidewalks on my block. It’s getting really hard to walk with my kids, and it feels unsafe with them darting around parked cars.

There’s a used car dealership on my street, and they keep parking their cars on the street and blocking the bike lane. I ride my bike to work, and it’s frustrating trying to navigate through all of this. This has been going on for weeks now!

Every morning, I have to dodge parked cars from that used car lot down the block. It’s really inconvenient, and I worry about my elderly neighbor who has trouble walking. Can someone do something about this?
